conditions and raise the standard of care globally.

# We’re tackling the world’s toughest health challenges

[ Medicines & therapies ][166]
Johnson & Johnson Innovative Medicine is leading where medicine is going. Patients inform and
inspire our science-based innovations, which continue to change and save lives. With rigorous
science and compassion, we confidently address the most complex diseases of our time and unlock the
medicines of tomorrow. Healthcare areas include: Oncology, Immunology, Neuroscience and
Cardiopulmonary.

[ Medical devices & technology ][172]
Johnson & Johnson MedTech innovates at the intersection of biology and technology. With a focus on
treating with pinpoint precision in the hardest-to-reach parts of the body, restoring anatomy and
reimagining healing, our portfolio of smarter, less invasive, more personalized treatments is
addressing the most complex health challenges. Healthcare areas include: Cardiovascular,
Orthopaedics, Surgery and Vision.

watch my 3-yearold grandson grow up. Since losing 86 pounds, I’m able to walk 10,000 steps a day,

receive from the staff.

feeling the same anymore and deep down knew something was wrong.

fire in me that changed my entire outlook on food! Now, I fuel my body with healthy foods, and I
don’t miss the junk I used to eat.

## FAQs

### How do I get started with Medi-Weightloss?

Getting started is easy: find your nearest Medi-Weightloss clinic and schedule a free assessment.
From there, you’ll come in for a new patient visit where we’ll review your medical history, run
labs, complete a body composition analysis, and build your personalized plan. You can find your
local clinic on our [Locations page][61] or call 1 (877) MED-LOSS to speak with our team today.

### Does my insurance cover any part of the program's cost?

Many of our locations are now accepting insurance and offer in-network providers with major
carriers. Because our program is physician-supervised and evidence-based, certain services provided
– such as the Initial Consultation, Office Visit and Preventive Medical Counseling – may be covered
by a patient’s insurance plan.

Please check with your insurance provider to determine whether your treatment is eligible for
reimbursement. Many of our locations welcome HSA and FSA accounts.

### How much does the program cost?

Program fees can vary for each individual. For specific pricing, call 1-877-MED-LOSS or find a
Medi-Weightloss location in your area by [clicking here.][62]

### Do I have to be overweight to participate? What if I only need to lose 10-15 pounds?

Whether you need to lose 10 or 110 pounds, Medi-Weightloss can help you reach your weight loss
goals. Our medical team will develop a customized program that will help you lose weight and
transition into a healthier lifestyle.

### Will I be hungry on this program?

Many patients report reduced hunger and increased energy.

### Is the Medi-Weightloss Program tax deductible?

We recommend you speak with your tax accountant to determine whether our program can be deducted
from your taxes.

### I am on a variety of medications; can I still participate in the program?

We have found that very few medications negatively interact with the Medi-Weightloss Program. When
you come in for your consultation, the practitioner will thoroughly review your medical history and
discuss it with you.

### I have diabetes; can I be on the program?

Yes. Our Medi-Weightloss Program is physician-supervised. Patients suffering from medical
conditions, including diabetes, can be treated with your doctor’s permission. Our program can help
you control your medical condition so that you can lead a healthier life.

  in asthetic medicine. A broad and well-coordinated portfolio of minimally invasive and
  non-invasive skin rejuvenation measures ensures that the needs and wishes of each patient can be
  individually addressed during treatment.
  
  Learn more about the portfolio of products that fuels confidence in every person.
  
  [Read more][33]
* ## Better Outcomes for More Patients
  
  At Merz Therapeutics, we relentlessly pursue innovative treatment and partnerships that aim to
  improve enduring quality of life for people living with neurological disorders. Our clinical
  development programs are designed to help more people benefit from the proven results of our
  heritage products while we seek opportunities to expand how we can serve patients in need.
  
  [Read more][34]
  
  We are constantly working to advance new treatment standards and improve the quality of research,
  education and patient care.
* ## About Merz Lifecare
  
  Merz Lifecare supports people in living a healthy life. Our tetesept, SOS, Zirkulin, Merz Spezial
  and Brooklyn Soap Company products empower consumers to make good choices about their health and
  well-being.
  
  Our brands offer a wide variety of products for health, well-being, body care and natural beauty:
  from head to toe and for babies to seniors.
  
  [Read more][35]
* ## Celebrating 110 years of Merz
  
  110 years ago, on March 9, 1918, the pharmacist and chemist Friedrich Merz founded the Chemische
  Fabrik Merz & Co. in Frankfurt am Main, Germany. Today, Merz remains a family-owned company, but
  has evolved into a global leader in aesthetic medicine and neurotoxin therapy.
  
  The motto of Friedrich Merz, who was born in 1884 in the town of Groß-Bieberau in the German
  Odenwald mountain range, was: “Trust yourself, be different, and invent products that are truly
  needed.“

## DAXXIFY® (daxibotulinumtoxinA-lanm) injection IMPORTANT SAFETY INFORMATION

### INDICATION

DAXXIFY® (daxibotulinumtoxinA-lanm) injection is an acetylcholine release inhibitor and
neuromuscular blocking agent indicated for the temporary improvement in the appearance of moderate
to severe glabellar lines associated with corrugator and/or procerus muscle activity in adult
patients and for the treatment of cervical dystonia in adults.

WARNING: DISTANT SPREAD OF TOXIN EFFECT
The effects of DAXXIFY® and all botulinum toxin products may spread from the area of injection to
produce symptoms consistent with botulinum toxin effects. These symptoms have been reported hours to
weeks after injection. Swallowing and breathing difficulties can be life threatening and there have
been reports of death. DAXXIFY® is not approved for the treatment of spasticity or any conditions
other than cervical dystonia and glabellar lines.

### IMPORTANT SAFETY INFORMATION


### Contraindications

DAXXIFY® contraindications include hypersensitivity to any botulinum toxin preparation or any of the
components in the formulation and infection at the injection site(s).

### Warnings and Precautions

Please refer to Boxed Warning for Distant Spread of Toxin Effect.

The potency units of DAXXIFY® are not interchangeable with preparations of other botulinum toxin
products. Recommended dose and frequency of administration should not be exceeded. Patients should
seek immediate medical attention if respiratory, speech or swallowing difficulties occur. Use
caution when administering to patients with pre-existing cardiovascular disease. Concomitant
neuromuscular disorders may exacerbate clinical effects of treatment.

### Adverse Reactions

The most commonly observed adverse reactions are:
Glabellar lines (≥1%): headache (6%), eyelid ptosis (2%) and facial paresis (1%).
Cervical dystonia (≥5%): headache (9%), injection site pain (8%), injection site erythema (5%),
muscular weakness (5%), and upper respiratory tract infection (5%).

### Drug Interactions

Co-administration of DAXXIFY® and aminoglycoside antibiotics, anticholinergic agents or any other
agents interfering with neuromuscular transmission or muscle relaxants should only be performed with
caution as the effect of DAXXIFY® may be potentiated. The effect of administering different
botulinum neurotoxins during course of treatment with DAXXIFY® is unknown.

### Use in Specific Populations

DAXXIFY® is not recommended for use in children or pregnant women.

**Please see DAXXIFY® full [Prescribing Information][14], including Boxed Warning and [Medication
Guide][15].**

**To report side effects associated with DAXXIFY®, please visit safety.revance.com, or call

[www.fda.gov/medwatch][18]**

## RHA® Collection of Fillers, by Teoxane

### Indications


The Teoxane RHA^{®} Collection of resilient hyaluronic acid (HA) fillers includes RHA Redensity^{®},
RHA^{®} 2, RHA^{®} 3 and RHA^{®} 4 with lidocaine and RHA Redensity^{®} Mepi, RHA^{®} 2 Mepi,
RHA^{®} 3 Mepi and RHA^{®} Dynamic Volume, with mepivacaine.

RHA Redensity^{®} and RHA Redensity^{®} Mepi are indicated for injection into the dermis and
superficial dermis of the face, for the correction of moderate to severe dynamic perioral rhytids in
adults 22 or older. RHA^{®} 2 and RHA^{®} 2 Mepi are indicated for injection into the mid-to-deep
dermis for the correction of moderate to severe dynamic facial wrinkles and folds, such as
nasolabial folds (NLFs) in adults 22 or older. RHA^{®} 3 and RHA^{®} 3 Mepi are indicated for
injection into the mid-to-deep dermis for the correction of moderate to severe dynamic facial
wrinkles and folds, such as nasolabial folds (NLFs) and is also indicated for injection into the
vermillion body, vermillion border and oral commissure to achieve lip augmentation and lip fullness
in adults 22 or older. RHA^{®} 4 is indicated for injection in the deep dermis to superficial
subcutaneous tissue for the correction of moderate to severe dynamic facial wrinkles and folds, such
as nasolabial folds (NLFs) in adults 22 or older. RHA^{®} 4 is indicated for injection in the deep
dermis to superficial subcutaneous tissue for the correction of moderate to severe dynamic facial
wrinkles and folds, such as nasolabial folds (NLFs) and for injection into the subcutaneous to
supraperiosteal layers for cheek augmentation and/or correction of age-related midface contour
deficiencies in adults 22 or older.

### IMPORTANT SAFETY INFORMATION


### Contraindications


Do not use in patients who have severe allergies, marked by a history of anaphylaxis or multiple
severe allergies, or in patients with a history of allergies to gram-positive bacterial proteins or
local anesthetics of the amide type, such as lidocaine and mepivacaine.

Do not use in patients with bleeding disorders.

### Warnings


Do not inject into blood vessels. Introduction of these products into the vasculature may lead to
embolization, occlusion of the vessels, ischemia, or infarction. Take extra care when injecting
soft-tissue fillers; for example, inject the product slowly and apply the least amount of pressure
necessary. Rare, but serious, adverse events associated with the intravascular injection of
soft-tissue fillers in the face have been reported and include temporary or permanent vision
impairment, blindness, cerebral ischemia or cerebral hemorrhage leading to stroke, skin necrosis,
and damage to underlying facial structures.

Immediately stop the injection if a patient exhibits any of the following symptoms: changes in
vision, signs of a stroke, blanching of the skin, or unusual pain during or shortly after the
procedure. Patients should receive prompt medical attention and, possibly, evaluation by an
appropriate healthcare professional specialist should an intravascular injection occur.

Product use at specific sites in which an active inflammatory process or infection is present should
be deferred until the underlying process has been controlled.

### Precautions


These products should only be used by healthcare professionals who have appropriate training,
experience, and knowledge of facial anatomy.

Discuss the potential risks of soft-tissue injections with your patients prior to treatment and
ensure that patients are aware of signs and symptoms of potential complications.

The safety and effectiveness for the treatment of anatomic regions other than the labeled
indications have not been established in controlled U.S. clinical studies

As with all transcutaneous procedures, dermal filler implantation carries a risk of infection.
Standard precautions associated with injectable materials should be followed.

The safety for use in sites in the presence of other implants, during pregnancy, in breastfeeding
females, and in patients with known susceptibility to keloid formation, hypertrophic scarring, and
pigmentation disorders has not been studied.

Use with caution in patients on immunosuppressive therapy.

Patients who are using products that can prolong bleeding (such as thrombolytics, anticoagulants, or
inhibitors of platelet aggregation) may experience increased bruising or bleeding at treatment
sites.

Patients with a history of herpetic eruptions may experience reactivation of the herpes.

There is a possible risk of inflammation at the implant site if laser treatments or a chemical peel
are performed after treatment.

Use as supplied. Modification or use of the product outside the Directions for Use may adversely
impact the sterility, safety, homogeneity, or performance of the product.

For single patient use. Do not reuse a syringe between two treatments and/or between two patients.
Do not resterilize.

### Adverse Events


The most commonly reported side effects were firmness, redness, tenderness, swelling, lumps/bumps,
bruising, discoloration, pain and itching. Most of these events were mild or moderate and resolved
within 14 days.

Delayed-onset inflammation near the site of dermal filler injections is one of the known adverse
events associated with dermal fillers. Cases of delayed-onset inflammation have been reported to
occur at the dermal filler treatment site following viral or bacterial illnesses or infections,
vaccinations, or dental procedures. Typically, the reported inflammation was responsive to treatment
or resolved on its own.

**To report an adverse event with any RHA^{®} product to Revance, please visit Safety.Revance.com or
call at [1 (877) 373-8669][20].**

Switzerland. The Teoxane RHA^{®} Collection is exclusively distributed by Revance^{®}. All other

## DAXXIFY® (daxibotulinumtoxinA-lanm) injection IMPORTANT SAFETY INFORMATION

### INDICATION

DAXXIFY® (daxibotulinumtoxinA-lanm) injection is an acetylcholine release inhibitor and
neuromuscular blocking agent indicated for the temporary improvement in the appearance of moderate
to severe glabellar lines associated with corrugator and/or procerus muscle activity in adult
patients and for the treatment of cervical dystonia in adults.

WARNING: DISTANT SPREAD OF TOXIN EFFECT
The effects of DAXXIFY® and all botulinum toxin products may spread from the area of injection to
produce symptoms consistent with botulinum toxin effects. These symptoms have been reported hours to
weeks after injection. Swallowing and breathing difficulties can be life threatening and there have
been reports of death. DAXXIFY® is not approved for the treatment of spasticity or any conditions
other than cervical dystonia and glabellar lines.

### IMPORTANT SAFETY INFORMATION


### Contraindications

DAXXIFY® contraindications include hypersensitivity to any botulinum toxin preparation or any of the
components in the formulation and infection at the injection site(s).

### Warnings and Precautions

Please refer to Boxed Warning for Distant Spread of Toxin Effect.

The potency units of DAXXIFY® are not interchangeable with preparations of other botulinum toxin
products. Recommended dose and frequency of administration should not be exceeded. Patients should
seek immediate medical attention if respiratory, speech or swallowing difficulties occur. Use
caution when administering to patients with pre-existing cardiovascular disease. Concomitant
neuromuscular disorders may exacerbate clinical effects of treatment.

### Adverse Reactions

The most commonly observed adverse reactions are:
Glabellar lines (≥1%): headache (6%), eyelid ptosis (2%) and facial paresis (1%).
Cervical dystonia (≥5%): headache (9%), injection site pain (8%), injection site erythema (5%),
muscular weakness (5%), and upper respiratory tract infection (5%).

### Drug Interactions

Co-administration of DAXXIFY® and aminoglycoside antibiotics, anticholinergic agents or any other
agents interfering with neuromuscular transmission or muscle relaxants should only be performed with
caution as the effect of DAXXIFY® may be potentiated. The effect of administering different
botulinum neurotoxins during course of treatment with DAXXIFY® is unknown.

### Use in Specific Populations

DAXXIFY® is not recommended for use in children or pregnant women.

**Please see DAXXIFY® full [Prescribing Information][14], including Boxed Warning and [Medication
Guide][15].**

**To report side effects associated with DAXXIFY®, please visit safety.revance.com, or call
[1-877-373-8669][16]. You may also report side effects to the FDA at [1-800-FDA-1088][17] or visit
[www.fda.gov/medwatch][18]**

[DAXI-004726]

The long-term efficacy and safety outcomes of RHA® with lidocaine are applicable to RHA® with
mepivacaine and mepivacaine has shown no significant impact on gel properties, including rheology
and degradation profile.

**[PLEASE SEE FULL DIRECTIONS FOR USE][19]**

## RHA® Collection of Fillers, by Teoxane

### Indications


The Teoxane RHA^{®} Collection of resilient hyaluronic acid (HA) fillers includes RHA Redensity^{®},
RHA^{®} 2, RHA^{®} 3 and RHA^{®} 4 with lidocaine and RHA Redensity^{®} Mepi, RHA^{®} 2 Mepi,
RHA^{®} 3 Mepi and RHA^{®} Dynamic Volume, with mepivacaine.

RHA Redensity^{®} and RHA Redensity^{®} Mepi are indicated for injection into the dermis and
superficial dermis of the face, for the correction of moderate to severe dynamic perioral rhytids in
adults 22 or older. RHA^{®} 2 and RHA^{®} 2 Mepi are indicated for injection into the mid-to-deep
dermis for the correction of moderate to severe dynamic facial wrinkles and folds, such as
nasolabial folds (NLFs) in adults 22 or older. RHA^{®} 3 and RHA^{®} 3 Mepi are indicated for
injection into the mid-to-deep dermis for the correction of moderate to severe dynamic facial
wrinkles and folds, such as nasolabial folds (NLFs) and is also indicated for injection into the
vermillion body, vermillion border and oral commissure to achieve lip augmentation and lip fullness
in adults 22 or older. RHA^{®} 4 is indicated for injection in the deep dermis to superficial
subcutaneous tissue for the correction of moderate to severe dynamic facial wrinkles and folds, such
as nasolabial folds (NLFs) in adults 22 or older. RHA^{®} 4 is indicated for injection in the deep
dermis to superficial subcutaneous tissue for the correction of moderate to severe dynamic facial
wrinkles and folds, such as nasolabial folds (NLFs) and for injection into the subcutaneous to
supraperiosteal layers for cheek augmentation and/or correction of age-related midface contour
deficiencies in adults 22 or older.

### IMPORTANT SAFETY INFORMATION


### Contraindications


Do not use in patients who have severe allergies, marked by a history of anaphylaxis or multiple
severe allergies, or in patients with a history of allergies to gram-positive bacterial proteins or
local anesthetics of the amide type, such as lidocaine and mepivacaine.

Do not use in patients with bleeding disorders.

### Warnings


Do not inject into blood vessels. Introduction of these products into the vasculature may lead to
embolization, occlusion of the vessels, ischemia, or infarction. Take extra care when injecting
soft-tissue fillers; for example, inject the product slowly and apply the least amount of pressure
necessary. Rare, but serious, adverse events associated with the intravascular injection of
soft-tissue fillers in the face have been reported and include temporary or permanent vision
impairment, blindness, cerebral ischemia or cerebral hemorrhage leading to stroke, skin necrosis,
and damage to underlying facial structures.

Immediately stop the injection if a patient exhibits any of the following symptoms: changes in
vision, signs of a stroke, blanching of the skin, or unusual pain during or shortly after the
procedure. Patients should receive prompt medical attention and, possibly, evaluation by an
appropriate healthcare professional specialist should an intravascular injection occur.

Product use at specific sites in which an active inflammatory process or infection is present should
be deferred until the underlying process has been controlled.

### Precautions


These products should only be used by healthcare professionals who have appropriate training,
experience, and knowledge of facial anatomy.

Discuss the potential risks of soft-tissue injections with your patients prior to treatment and
ensure that patients are aware of signs and symptoms of potential complications.

The safety and effectiveness for the treatment of anatomic regions other than the labeled
indications have not been established in controlled U.S. clinical studies

As with all transcutaneous procedures, dermal filler implantation carries a risk of infection.
Standard precautions associated with injectable materials should be followed.

The safety for use in sites in the presence of other implants, during pregnancy, in breastfeeding
females, and in patients with known susceptibility to keloid formation, hypertrophic scarring, and
pigmentation disorders has not been studied.

Use with caution in patients on immunosuppressive therapy.

Patients who are using products that can prolong bleeding (such as thrombolytics, anticoagulants, or
inhibitors of platelet aggregation) may experience increased bruising or bleeding at treatment
sites.

Patients with a history of herpetic eruptions may experience reactivation of the herpes.

There is a possible risk of inflammation at the implant site if laser treatments or a chemical peel
are performed after treatment.

Use as supplied. Modification or use of the product outside the Directions for Use may adversely
impact the sterility, safety, homogeneity, or performance of the product.

For single patient use. Do not reuse a syringe between two treatments and/or between two patients.
Do not resterilize.

### Adverse Events


The most commonly reported side effects were firmness, redness, tenderness, swelling, lumps/bumps,
bruising, discoloration, pain and itching. Most of these events were mild or moderate and resolved
within 14 days.

Delayed-onset inflammation near the site of dermal filler injections is one of the known adverse
events associated with dermal fillers. Cases of delayed-onset inflammation have been reported to
occur at the dermal filler treatment site following viral or bacterial illnesses or infections,
vaccinations, or dental procedures. Typically, the reported inflammation was responsive to treatment
or resolved on its own.

**To report an adverse event with any RHA^{®} product to Revance, please visit Safety.Revance.com or
call at [1 (877) 373-8669][20].**

trademarks are the property of their respective owners.**

## As Seen In The Media

# Luis Macias, MD Double board-certified plastic surgeon in Los Angeles

[about]
[ Play Video ][137]

## Dr. Macias

Dr. Luis Macias is a double-board-certified plastic surgeon who brings a global perspective and
elite training to his facial plastic surgery practice in Marina del Rey. Dr. Macias frequently
travels abroad to collaborate with world-renowned surgeons and stay at the forefront of surgical
techniques. He specializes in facial procedures, including facelifts, neck lifts, blepharoplasty,
brow lifts, and rhinoplasty, all of which are performed at his fully accredited MdR Surgery Center.

[Meet the Surgeon][138]
[signature]

## Dr. Macias

Dr. Luis Macias is a double-board-certified plastic surgeon who brings a global perspective and
elite training to his facial plastic surgery practice in Marina del Rey. Dr. Macias frequently
travels abroad to collaborate with world-renowned surgeons and stay at the forefront of surgical
techniques. He specializes in facial procedures, including facelifts, neck lifts, blepharoplasty,
brow lifts, and rhinoplasty, all of which are performed at his fully accredited MdR Surgery Center.

[Meet the Surgeon][138]
[signature]

Facelift Procedures

## Top Facelift Specialist In Los Angeles

Located in Los Angeles, Dr. Luis Macias has become one of the top facelift surgeons in the city,
helping patients achieve a natural-looking facial rejuvenation while using state-of-the-art
techniques. Dr. Macias has performed hundreds of facelift surgeries, is a double board-certified
plastic surgeon, and a valued member of the Aesthetic Society, one of the most prestigious societies
in plastic surgery.

AKTİF Internatıonal Hakkında

Aktif International, sağlık alanında hasta merkezli yaklaşımıyla en iyi hizmeti hedefleyerek, çağdaş
ve bilimsel tedavi yöntemlerini, uluslararası düzeyde hastalarına sunmaktadır. Aktif International
güven, güler yüz ve hasta memnuniyetini temel alan yaklaşımıyla, beş farklı hastaneyi zaman
içerisinde bünyesine katarak Marmara Bölgesinde öne çıkan sağlık kuruluşlarından biri haline
gelmiştir.

Aktif International Hastaneler Grubu’nun yolculuğu, 1999 yılında Özel Yalova Uzmanlar Hastanesi’nin
kuruluşu ile başlamıştır. 2010 yılında Özel Yalova Aktif Hastanesi’nin ve daha sonra 1998 yılında
Yunus Emre Hastanesi adıyla kurulup 2020 yılında Hürrem Sultan Hastanesi ismini alan üçüncü
hastanemizin katılımıyla devam etmiştir. 2009 yılında kurulan Özel Kocaeli Hastanesi 2021 yılında
Özel Aktif Kocaeli Hastanesi ismiyle ve İstanbul Bahçelievler’deki Vital Hospital ise 2022 yılında
hastane grubu bünyesine katılmıştır. Bu son iki hastanenin de katılımıyla toplamda 5 hastane 2023
yılında Aktif International adıyla tek bir şemsiye altında toplanmıştır.

Aktif International tüm hastane ve kliniklerinde yaklaşık 2000 kişilik bir sağlık ordusuyla, modern
tıbbın gerektirdiği tüm teknolojik alt yapı ve modern tedavi yaklaşımıyla, her biri kendi alanında
uzmanlaşmış profesyonel ekipleriyle, hastalarına güvenilir ve kaliteli sağlık hizmetleri
sunmaktadır. Sağlık turizmi vizyonuyla global ölçekte önemli bir oyuncu haline gelen ve
yatırımlarına devam eden Aktif International, Türkiye’yi uluslararası platformlarda gururla temsil
etmektedir.

## FAQ’s

How do I know if I’m a good candidate for plastic surgery?
A good candidate for plastic surgery is typically someone who is in good overall health, has
realistic goals and expectations, and is getting surgery for personal reasons. At your consultation,
your surgeon will discuss your medical history and treatment goals to make sure that surgery is the
best option for you.
How long does recovery take for plastic surgery?
The recovery time for plastic surgery can vary depending on the procedure and the individual
patient, but in general, initial recovery takes about 1–2 weeks. Full recovery and final results may
take several weeks to a few months. Your surgeon will provide detailed instructions for your
recovery to help ensure the best, safest, and most comfortable healing process.
Are the results of plastic surgery permanent?
The results of many plastic surgery procedures are long-lasting, but they may not be completely
permanent. Aging, lifestyle, and changes in weight and body shape can all affect results over time.
Adhering to healthy habits can help you maintain your outcome.
Are there any risks involved with plastic surgery?
Like any surgery, plastic surgery involves some risks, including infection, scarring, bleeding, and
complications with anesthesia. Choosing a board-certified surgeon, like Dr. Barnett at Alpine
Plastic Surgery, and following pre- and post-operative instructions can minimize risks.
How much does plastic surgery cost?
The cost of plastic surgery can vary depending on the type of procedure, the surgeon’s experience,
and the location of the practice. You will receive a personalized estimate at your consultation,
which will also include facility and anesthesia fees.

your surgeon will discuss your medical history and treatment goals to make sure that surgery is the
best option for you.
How long does recovery take for plastic surgery?
The recovery time for plastic surgery can vary depending on the procedure and the individual
patient, but in general, initial recovery takes about 1–2 weeks. Full recovery and final results may
take several weeks to a few months. Your surgeon will provide detailed instructions for your
recovery to help ensure the best, safest, and most comfortable healing process.
Are the results of plastic surgery permanent?
The results of many plastic surgery procedures are long-lasting, but they may not be completely
permanent. Aging, lifestyle, and changes in weight and body shape can all affect results over time.
Adhering to healthy habits can help you maintain your outcome.
Are there any risks involved with plastic surgery?
Like any surgery, plastic surgery involves some risks, including infection, scarring, bleeding, and
complications with anesthesia. Choosing a board-certified surgeon, like Dr. Barnett at Alpine
Plastic Surgery, and following pre- and post-operative instructions can minimize risks.
How much does plastic surgery cost?
The cost of plastic surgery can vary depending on the type of procedure, the surgeon’s experience,
and the location of the practice. You will receive a personalized estimate at your consultation,
which will also include facility and anesthesia fees.

[Dr. Unnikrishnan S, plastic surgeon at Amicus Clinic, Trivandrum]
Dr. Unnikrishnan S, MCh — Plastic Surgeon
ISAPS | IAAPS | Rhinoplasty Society of India
*Amicus means friend. *
**If you are reading this, something has probably been on your mind for a while.**

It could be something you have wanted to change for years, or something more recent. Either way, it
is a personal decision, and we respect that. Many people who come to us feel a mix of wanting this
and being unsure about it at the same time. That is normal. You are not the only one. Our job is not
to convince you. It is to help you think it through clearly, and if you do go ahead, to make sure it
is done safely and honestly — with someone who actually cares how it turns out.

**Before you decide. 
**Two things worth thinking about.**

1. Why do you want this?**
There is no wrong reason. It could be for a specific occasion, or something you have quietly carried
for a long time, or simply wanting to feel more like yourself. Whatever it is, talking it through
with someone you trust helps — a friend, a family member, or us.
**2. What would a good result look like for you?**
Surgery can do a lot, but it cannot do everything. We will tell you honestly what is achievable for
your situation and what is not. If we think a procedure is not right for you, we will say so.

**How we work**
Two types of procedures we do, 

**Smaller procedures** 
Things like scar revision, mole removal, small swellings. Local anesthesia. You go home the same
day. Most people are back to light work the next day.

**Bigger procedures** 
Things like gynecomastia correction, rhinoplasty, breast augmentation and reduction, liposuction,
and abdominoplasty (tummy tuck). These need general anesthesia and a short hospital stay. Recovery
takes longer, but we'll walk you through every step.
We'll help you understand which option fits your situation—and what to expect before, during, and
after.

# Plastic Surgeon in Norwalk, CT

Precision Care, Woman to Woman
* Board-certified with elite training at Johns Hopkins & Yale
* Specialized in labiaplasty and other women’s procedures
* Fluent in Russian, French, Hebrew & Spanish
* 300+ 5-star Google reviews

[Call Us Today][13] [Book an Appointment][14]

Dr. Kishinevsky


## Why 
## Choose **Dr. Kishinevsky**

### Elite Credentials & Recognized Excellence

[Dr. Kishinevsky][15] is board-certified by the American Board of Plastic Surgery and trained at
some of the most respected institutions in the country, including Johns Hopkins, Yale, and Albert
Einstein College of Medicine. Her commitment to patient safety and surgical precision has earned her
multiple Top Doctor honors from Connecticut Magazine and other organizations.

### Compassionate, Multilingual & Women-Focused

As a female plastic surgeon, Dr. Kishinevsky offers a thoughtful approach to procedures like
[labiaplasty][16] and [breast surgery][17], helping patients feel heard, respected, and fully
supported. She is fluent in Russian, French, and Hebrew, and conversational in Spanish, which allows
her to connect with a diverse range of women seeking expert care in a safe, inclusive environment.

### A Surgeon Who Gives Beyond the Practice

From complex reconstructive procedures for trauma survivors to international surgical missions with
Healing the Children®, Dr. Kishinevsky is deeply committed to using her skills to make a difference.
Her volunteer work reflects a lifelong dedication to compassionate care in Norwalk and across the
globe.

[Call Us Today][18] [Book an Appointment][19]

## A Surgeon With 
## Depth, Dedication, 
## and Vision

Get to Know Dr. Anya Kishinevsky

Dr. Kishinevsky has been practicing plastic and reconstructive surgery since 2006. Over two decades,
she’s earned a reputation not only for her surgical results, but for the calm, confident guidance
she provides every step of the way.

Her experience includes:
* 20 years in private practice
* Training with world-renowned plastic surgeons
* Advanced expertise in [microsurgical breast reconstruction][20]
* Hospital affiliations in Norwalk, Bridgeport, Stamford & more
* A lifelong dedication to mentoring future medical professionals

From first consult to final follow-up, Dr. Kishinevsky approaches every case with professionalism,
artistry, and a genuine care for her patients’ long-term confidence.

[More About Dr. Kishinevsky][21]

## Comfort and Confidence at Every Step

“Dr. Kishinevsky is kind, compassionate, professional and very gentle. She made me feel comfortable
and reassured me that I could contact her with any concerns. Her staff is knowledgable and was
receptive to any follow up questions I asked.”

— Slr,** **[5-Star Review][22]

[Call Us Today][23] [Book an Appointment][24]

## Modern Medicine, Warmth, & Community

Step inside our Norwalk practice

Dr. Kishinevsky’s Norwalk office is located in a modern medical facility just off I-95, with
convenient public parking and easy access for patients from Bridgeport and across Fairfield County.
The space was thoughtfully designed with your comfort in mind, from river views in every room to
calming interiors and a dedicated children’s area.

All nonsurgical treatments take place here, while major procedures requiring general anesthesia are
performed at trusted local hospitals and surgical centers. This allows [Dr. Kishinevsky][25] to
provide high-level care across multiple settings without sacrificing continuity or personal
attention.

Dr. Kishinevsky lives and works in Norwalk, and she’s deeply connected to the community. She mentors
local high school students through Norwalk Hospital’s outreach program and regularly speaks at
medical career days at Norwalk and Brien McMahon High Schools.

This 20-year-old patient came to Dr. Kishinevsky seeking both aesthetic refinement and relief from

the nasal tip, and placed spreader grafts to support breathing, creating a nose that’s more
balanced, elegant, and functional.

precision. This outpatient procedure reduces discomfort, improves symmetry, and helps women feel

## Facelift in Miami

Dr. White’s facelift incorporates the best aspects of modern facial reconstruction and plastic
surgery in a comprehensive procedure to restore and revitalize the face and neck. By combining a
facelift and [neck lift][232] and adding [fat grafting][233] around the midface, Dr. White artfully
repositions the skin and muscles of the face and neck in a way that drastically reduces wrinkles,
sagging skin, volume loss, and other signs of facial aging. This once-in-a-lifetime procedure will
restore a younger, more vibrant profile that looks like you, only much younger.

## Miami Blepharoplasty

Eyelid lifts (blepharoplasty) are a subtle yet effective way to revitalize your look. Dr. White
performs this procedure on the upper eyelid, lower eyelid, or both eyelids, with no visible scarring
and natural-looking results. This procedure tightens the skin around the eyelids, correcting any
sagging or drooping, and can also get rid of bulges or fatty pockets beneath the eyes. The result is
a *dramatically refreshed look with minimal downtime*.

# Welcome to **Avance Plastic Surgery Institute**
# **Best in Reno**

Welcome to [Avance Plastic Surgery Institute][222]. Led by Harvard-educated and fellowship-trained
plastic and reconstructive surgeon Dr. Erez Dayan, we offer the most advanced cosmetic and

The Avance Plastic Surgery Institute staff is the finest team of medical professionals you will find

# Welcome to **Avance Plastic Surgery Institute**
# **Best in Reno**

Welcome to [Avance Plastic Surgery Institute][222]. Led by Harvard-educated and fellowship-trained
plastic and reconstructive surgeon Dr. Erez Dayan, we offer the most advanced cosmetic and
reconstructive surgical procedures and state-of-the-art technology for aesthetic treatments.
Patients of the Institute can expect an individualized plan developed from a full range of aesthetic
treatments, including surgical, minimally invasive and non-invasive.

Avance Plastic Surgery Institute is an internationally recognized and published center for research
and development of aesthetic technologies and techniques. In fact, it is one of only two medical
institutes across the globe that are conducting trials for the latest hands-free skin tightening
radiofrequency technology by InMode, a top aesthetics technology company. We also regularly host
physicians and surgeons from around the world for didactic, observational courses to improve their
techniques and use of aesthetic devices.

The Avance Plastic Surgery Institute staff is the finest team of medical professionals you will find
anywhere, chosen for their experience and top-tier training in various fields of medicine and
aesthetics. Patients who choose treatment from the Avance Plastic Surgery Institute enjoy
revolutionary aesthetic treatments at the hands of compassionate, well-trained medical staff and
team members.

Expert care

Certified surgeons and experienced medical providers specializing in customized body

Comprehensive solutions

Trusted results

## What we do

We offer guaranteed, natural-looking transformations with board-certified surgeons and less risk.

##### Body

##### Face

##### Breast & Chest

##### Skin Tightening

##### BelleSculpt 360

Sculpt multiple areas in one session with our signature, full-body fat removal procedure—minimally
invasive with maximum results.

[Learn more][41]

##### Tummy tuck

Remove excess skin and tighten the abdominal area for a smoother, flatter midsection—ideal after
weight loss or pregnancy.

[Learn more][42]

##### BelleSculpt (lipo)

Target stubborn fat with advanced vibration-assisted lipo—refining and reshaping your body without
the need for general anesthesia.

[Learn more][43]

##### Chin Sculpting (Lipo)

Permanently remove double chin fat and sculpt your lower face with our precise, minimally invasive
chin lipo treatment.

[Learn more][44]

##### Breast augmentation

Enhance your shape with natural-looking volume—using implants or your own fat, based on your goals.

[Learn more][45]

##### Natural fat transfer

Use your body’s own fat to subtly and naturally enhance the breasts without implants or synthetic
materials.

[Learn more][46]

##### Gynecomastia reduction

Reduce volume and reshape the chest with tailored procedures for men—designed for comfort and
confidence.

[Learn more][47]

##### Arms

Tighten loose or crepey skin on the upper arms for a smoother, firmer look—no surgery required.

[Learn more][48]

##### Body

Lift and tighten sagging skin on the abdomen, thighs, or back for a more sculpted silhouette and
restored skin elasticity.

[Learn more][49]

##### Face

Rejuvenate your appearance by tightening skin on the cheeks, jawline, and neck with minimally
invasive techniques.

[Learn more][50]

About the Surgeon

## Dr. Farhad *Rafizadeh*

Board certified in both General Surgery and Plastic Surgery by the American Board of Plastic
Surgery, Dr. Rafizadeh has practiced in Morristown, NJ since 1984. A Fellow of the American College
of Surgeons (FACS) and active member of the American Society of Plastic Surgeons (ASPS) and the
International Society of Aesthetic Plastic Surgery (ISAPS), he has been recognized as a Castle
Connolly Top Doctor and NJ Monthly Top Surgeon year after year.

Before becoming a surgeon, he was an artist. That innate sense of proportion, harmony, and the
golden ratio informs every procedure he performs — delivering results that look natural, not
operated. His patients — most of them in their 50s, 60s, and 70s — describe the goal the same way:
*“refreshed, not different”* — you, just rested. That philosophy of conservative, natural
rejuvenation has defined the practice for four decades. Learn more about Dr. Rafizadeh, a board
certified [plastic surgeon in NJ][10] serving Morristown and northern New Jersey.

Trained in Lausanne, Switzerland

## The Surgeon.
## *The Artist.*
## The Standard.

Dr. Farhad Rafizadeh, MD FACS is board-certified in both General Surgery and Plastic Surgery.
Trained at the Lausanne Medical School in Switzerland and recognized in the *Aesthetic Surgery
Journal* for his artistic mastery, Dr. Rafizadeh has performed thousands of procedures across
[facelift and facial rejuvenation][12], [breast surgery][13], and [body contouring][14].

His patients travel from throughout New Jersey, New York City, and across the country for his
signature approach: results that are refined, balanced, and unmistakably natural. Dr. Rafizadeh
holds a degree from Cornell's Plastic Surgery Program at NewYork-Presbyterian hospital and is a
member of ASPS and ISAPS. Read what patients say on our [reviews page][15] or explore the [blog][16]
for over 140 articles on plastic surgery topics.

[ [Aesthetic Surgery Journal Vol. 26 Issue 5 — cover art by Dr. Farhad Rafizadeh] ][17]
Featured Artist *Aesthetic Surgery Journal*
[View Artwork →][18]

Before becoming a surgeon, Dr. Rafizadeh was a painter. The Aesthetic Society has invited him to
feature his original works on the covers of the *Aesthetic Surgery Journal* — one of the most
prestigious publications in the field.

Cover art: “Nude in Blue,” oil on canvas by Farhad Rafizadeh, MD, Morristown, NJ, board-certified
plastic surgeon and ASAPS member.

A Specialty, Not a Side Procedure

### Deep Plane
### *Facelift*

Dr. Rafizadeh is among a select group of surgeons in the New York–New Jersey region who performs the
deep plane facelift as his primary facial rejuvenation technique. Unlike the superficial SMAS
facelift, the deep plane approach releases facial ligaments at their root, restoring volume, lifting
the midface, and producing results that look decades younger — without the "pulled" appearance.

[View Facelift Results →][19]

Now Welcoming Consultations

## Dr. Andre *Rafizadeh*

A fellowship-trained plastic surgeon and lifelong New Jersey native, Dr. Andre Rafizadeh earned his
MD *cum laude* from St. George’s University, completed his general surgery residency at Morristown
Medical Center — where he served as Chief Resident — and is board certified in General Surgery by
the American Board of Surgery and **board eligible in plastic surgery**.

At the University at Buffalo Plastic & Reconstructive Surgery Fellowship, he trained across the full
breadth of the specialty — developing a deep understanding of facial and body plastic surgery, along
with expertise in reconstructive procedures of the face and body and a wide variety of breast
reconstruction cases. Now joining Better Plastic Surgery, Dr. Andre is accepting new patients for a
[personal consultation][20].

About the Surgeon

## Dr. Farhad *Rafizadeh*

Board certified in both General Surgery and Plastic Surgery by the American Board of Plastic
Surgery, Dr. Rafizadeh has practiced in Morristown, NJ since 1984. A Fellow of the American College
of Surgeons (FACS) and active member of the American Society of Plastic Surgeons (ASPS) and the
International Society of Aesthetic Plastic Surgery (ISAPS), he has been recognized as a Castle
Connolly Top Doctor and NJ Monthly Top Surgeon year after year.

Before becoming a surgeon, he was an artist. That innate sense of proportion, harmony, and the
golden ratio informs every procedure he performs — delivering results that look natural, not
operated. His patients — most of them in their 50s, 60s, and 70s — describe the goal the same way:
*“refreshed, not different”* — you, just rested. That philosophy of conservative, natural
rejuvenation has defined the practice for four decades. Learn more about Dr. Rafizadeh, a board
certified [plastic surgeon in NJ][10] serving Morristown and northern New Jersey.

## The Surgeon.
## *The Artist.*
## The Standard.

Dr. Farhad Rafizadeh, MD FACS is board-certified in both General Surgery and Plastic Surgery.
Trained at the Lausanne Medical School in Switzerland and recognized in the *Aesthetic Surgery
Journal* for his artistic mastery, Dr. Rafizadeh has performed thousands of procedures across
[facelift and facial rejuvenation][12], [breast surgery][13], and [body contouring][14].

His patients travel from throughout New Jersey, New York City, and across the country for his
signature approach: results that are refined, balanced, and unmistakably natural. Dr. Rafizadeh
holds a degree from Cornell's Plastic Surgery Program at NewYork-Presbyterian hospital and is a
member of ASPS and ISAPS. Read what patients say on our [reviews page][15] or explore the [blog][16]
for over 140 articles on plastic surgery topics.

[View Artwork →][18]

Before becoming a surgeon, Dr. Rafizadeh was a painter. The Aesthetic Society has invited him to
feature his original works on the covers of the *Aesthetic Surgery Journal* — one of the most
prestigious publications in the field.

Cover art: “Nude in Blue,” oil on canvas by Farhad Rafizadeh, MD, Morristown, NJ, board-certified
plastic surgeon and ASAPS member.

A Specialty, Not a Side Procedure

### Deep Plane
### *Facelift*

Dr. Rafizadeh is among a select group of surgeons in the New York–New Jersey region who performs the
deep plane facelift as his primary facial rejuvenation technique. Unlike the superficial SMAS
facelift, the deep plane approach releases facial ligaments at their root, restoring volume, lifting
the midface, and producing results that look decades younger — without the "pulled" appearance.

[View Facelift Results →][19]

Now Welcoming Consultations

## Dr. Andre *Rafizadeh*

A fellowship-trained plastic surgeon and lifelong New Jersey native, Dr. Andre Rafizadeh earned his
MD *cum laude* from St. George’s University, completed his general surgery residency at Morristown
Medical Center — where he served as Chief Resident — and is board certified in General Surgery by
the American Board of Surgery and **board eligible in plastic surgery**.

At the University at Buffalo Plastic & Reconstructive Surgery Fellowship, he trained across the full
breadth of the specialty — developing a deep understanding of facial and body plastic surgery, along
with expertise in reconstructive procedures of the face and body and a wide variety of breast
reconstruction cases. Now joining Better Plastic Surgery, Dr. Andre is accepting new patients for a
[personal consultation][20].

#### Featured Services

###### [View all][72]

## Breast Augmentation

Enhance the size, shape, and symmetry of your breasts with breast augmentation surgery at bŏdze in
Tampa. Using implants, this procedure helps restore fullness and balance, boosting confidence with
natural-looking results.

[Breast Augmentation Info][73]
[Breast Augmentation][74]

## Tummy Tuck

Tummy Tuck surgery, also known as Abdominoplasty surgery, removes excess skin and fat while
tightening abdominal muscles for a firmer, flatter stomach. This procedure is ideal after weight
loss to restore a contoured, confident profile.

[Tummy Tuck Info][75]
[Abdominoplasty (Tummy Tuck)][76]

## Brazilian Butt Lift (BBL)

A Brazilian Butt Lift surgery (BBL) combines liposuction with fat transfer to enhance the shape and
volume of the buttocks. This procedure creates a fuller, more balanced silhouette while naturally
sculpting your waist and midsection.

[BBL Info][77]
[Brazilian Butt Lift (BBL)][78]

## Liposuction 360

Lipo 360 surgery sculpts the entire midsection, targeting the abdomen, obliques, and lower back, for
a more defined silhouette. This comprehensive body contouring procedure is perfect for achieving a
slimmer, more proportionate shape.

[Liposuction 360 Info][79]
[Liposuction 360][80]

## Breast Lift

A breast lift surgery (mastopexy) restores youthful shape and position by removing excess skin and
tightening surrounding tissue. This procedure rejuvenates sagging breasts, creating a firmer, more
uplifted contour.

[Breast Lift Info][81]
[Breast Lift (Mastopexy)][82]

## Wrinkle Relaxers

Smooth away fine lines and dynamic wrinkles with our wrinkle relaxers: Botox, Dysport, Xeomin, and
Daxxify. Each treatment is tailored to your needs, helping you achieve natural, refreshed results
that restore youthful vibrance.

[Book Wrinkle Relaxer Appointment][83]
[Wrinkle Relaxers][84]

## Facelift

A facelift surgery (rhytidectomy) lifts and tightens the skin and deeper tissues of the face and
neck, reducing sagging and deep creases. This procedure creates a smoother, more youthful appearance
while enhancing natural facial contours.

[Facelift Info][85]
[Facelift (rhytidectomy)][86]

## Morpheus8

Morpheus8 combines microneedling with radiofrequency energy to tighten skin, reduce wrinkles, and
remodel collagen. This non-invasive treatment improves skin tone and texture, delivering a smoother,
more youthful look.

[Morpheus8 Info][87]
[Morpheus8][88]

## Gynecomastia

Gynecomastia surgery (male breast reduction) reduces enlarged male breasts by removing excess tissue
and fat, creating a flatter, more masculine chest. This procedure restores balance and confidence
for men affected by this common condition.

[Gynecomastia Info][89]

#### Featured Services

###### [View all][72]

## Breast Augmentation

Enhance the size, shape, and symmetry of your breasts with breast augmentation surgery at bŏdze in
Tampa. Using implants, this procedure helps restore fullness and balance, boosting confidence with
natural-looking results.

[Breast Augmentation Info][73]
[Breast Augmentation][74]

## Tummy Tuck

Tummy Tuck surgery, also known as Abdominoplasty surgery, removes excess skin and fat while
tightening abdominal muscles for a firmer, flatter stomach. This procedure is ideal after weight
loss to restore a contoured, confident profile.

[Tummy Tuck Info][75]
[Abdominoplasty (Tummy Tuck)][76]

## Brazilian Butt Lift (BBL)

A Brazilian Butt Lift surgery (BBL) combines liposuction with fat transfer to enhance the shape and
volume of the buttocks. This procedure creates a fuller, more balanced silhouette while naturally
sculpting your waist and midsection.

[BBL Info][77]
[Brazilian Butt Lift (BBL)][78]

## Liposuction 360

Lipo 360 surgery sculpts the entire midsection, targeting the abdomen, obliques, and lower back, for
a more defined silhouette. This comprehensive body contouring procedure is perfect for achieving a
slimmer, more proportionate shape.

[Liposuction 360 Info][79]
[Liposuction 360][80]

## Breast Lift

A breast lift surgery (mastopexy) restores youthful shape and position by removing excess skin and
tightening surrounding tissue. This procedure rejuvenates sagging breasts, creating a firmer, more
uplifted contour.

[Breast Lift Info][81]
[Breast Lift (Mastopexy)][82]

## Wrinkle Relaxers

Smooth away fine lines and dynamic wrinkles with our wrinkle relaxers: Botox, Dysport, Xeomin, and
Daxxify. Each treatment is tailored to your needs, helping you achieve natural, refreshed results
that restore youthful vibrance.

[Book Wrinkle Relaxer Appointment][83]
[Wrinkle Relaxers][84]

## Facelift

A facelift surgery (rhytidectomy) lifts and tightens the skin and deeper tissues of the face and
neck, reducing sagging and deep creases. This procedure creates a smoother, more youthful appearance
while enhancing natural facial contours.

[Facelift Info][85]
[Facelift (rhytidectomy)][86]

## Morpheus8

Morpheus8 combines microneedling with radiofrequency energy to tighten skin, reduce wrinkles, and
remodel collagen. This non-invasive treatment improves skin tone and texture, delivering a smoother,
more youthful look.

[Morpheus8 Info][87]
[Morpheus8][88]

## Gynecomastia

Gynecomastia surgery (male breast reduction) reduces enlarged male breasts by removing excess tissue
and fat, creating a flatter, more masculine chest. This procedure restores balance and confidence
for men affected by this common condition.

[Gynecomastia Info][89]
[Gynecomastia][90]

Dr. Joseph F. Capella | MD, F.A.C.S.

Dr. Joseph F. Capella is a nationally and internationally recognized leading expert in **body
contouring** surgery.

He lectures and provides instructional courses on a regular basis at the symposia of some of the
most prestigious plastic surgery organizations in the world. With the most extensive experience and
the largest published series of cases on *body contouring after weight loss* in the world, Dr.
Capella is constantly striving to deliver a better experience for patients through both practice and
leadership.

Dr. Capella has also published numerous peer-reviewed articles and appeared in prominent media
outlets, showcasing the amazing transformations that change lives for the better. Browse his
extensive list of publications, lectures, courses, and videos to learn more about how Dr. Capella’s
personal knowledge and experience contribute to advancing the safety, effectiveness, and science of
*post-weight loss body contouring*.

Specializing in Cosmetic Surgery and Plastic Surgery after Weight Loss in New Jersey

Plastic surgery pioneer Dr. Joseph F. Capella is specializing in **body contouring after weight
loss**. *With over 25 years of experience and 25,000+ plastic surgery procedures* (including more
than 15,000 in body contouring after weight loss), he is internationally recognized for his
expertise and innovation. 

Dr. Capella is actively involved in **plastic surgery** organizations and regularly lectures at
prestigious symposia. Patients and other surgeons from around the world seek his expertise.

## Confidence at Every Angle

An Experience that is Second to None

Confidence means peace of mind.

Care and treatment from Dr. Capella allows each patient to undergo surgery with the utmost
confidence in their choice of provider. With countless accolades, top doctor awards, and a
reputation for world-class results, Dr. Capella is dedicated to helping patients have a safe and
beneficial experience from start to finish.

For patients who have recently (or not so recently) lost weight, Dr. Capella understands the
physical and emotional impact that the excess loose skin can have after a difficult weight loss
journey. After weight loss, *body sculpting* **plastic surgery** expertly performed by Dr. Capella
can help you live confidently and comfortably.

Throughout every step of your treatment, you can expect Dr. Capella and his team to do everything
they can to provide you with optimally successful and enjoyable treatment and confidence that can
last a lifetime.

### Transformative Change

## Body Lift in New Jersey

A surgical body lift offers comprehensive benefits for those seeking a transformational change. It
effectively removes excess skin and tightens underlying tissues across the body, resulting in a more
toned and contoured appearance. The procedure can enhance body shape, restore confidence, and
improve mobility. It also reduces discomfort caused by loose skin, allowing for a more free and
fulfilling lifestyle.

A surgical body lift offers comprehensive benefits for those seeking a transformational change. It
effectively removes excess skin and tightens underlying tissues across the body, resulting in a more
toned and contoured appearance. The procedure can enhance body shape, restore confidence, and

## Lavinia K. Chong, M.D.

Experienced and Compassionate Plastic Surgeon

## Lavinia K. Chong, M.D.

Dr. Lavinia Chong is a second-generation cosmetic surgeon practicing in Newport Beach, California.
She is dedicated to providing the highest quality patient-centric care to her patients. Her caring
manner, attentiveness, and outgoing personality make her practice one of the most popular in the
area. Her skills as a surgeon are supported by an experienced staff that has been well-trained to
recognize and respect the rights of her patients while providing a pleasant, safe and caring
environment.

[MEET DR. CHONG ][197]

## Mommy Makeover

Read More » ][198]

Having a baby means your body goes through extraordinary changes. A Mommy Makeover is a customized
set of procedures that help change your body back to a look you will love.

[Mommy Makeover Overview][199]

[

## Facelift

Read More » ][200]

Facial aging is inevitable; no one is immune. Fortunately, techniques have evolved in tandem with
both the consumer and provider’s perception of what constitutes “attractiveness”.

[Facelift Overview][201]

Procedures Tailored To You
[

## Breast Augmentation

Read More » ][202]

Many women feel that their breasts are disproportionately small for their figures. Breast
augmentation enhances breast size and volume for a more comfortable figure you’ll love.

[Breast Augmentation Overview][203]

Procedures Tailored To You
[

## Breast Revision

Read More » ][204]

Occasionally changes occur after breast implant surgery due to natural changes to the breast tissue,
or natural changes resulting from childbirth and breastfeeding that requires revision. Breast
revision restores breast shape and symmetry for renewed confidence in your appearance.

[Breast Revision Overview][205]

## Your Plastic Surgery Journey Is All In One Place

Our facility is accredited by the Institute of Medical Quality, a division of the California Medical
Association, and has passed surveys successfully, since 1996. The practice of Lavinia K. Chong, M.D.
maintains a vigorous Quality Assurance program to ensure that all equipment, personnel, and
protocols are regularly inspected, trained, and formatted to the highest standard of excellence. 

[ABOUT OUR PRACTICE ][206]

Life Changing Results

quick after my first consultation and the staff was all amazing. I highly recommend anyone to go to
her.” – Jennie R.

## Real Plastic Surgery Results

We are an increasingly visual society. The age of selfies and social media has prompted focus on our
outward appearance more than ever. Whether we are contemplating plastic surgery procedures to
freshen our appearance, repair what we perceive to be an imperfection, or simply strive to become
the best physical versions of ourselves, visual displays help us discover available options and
guide us in setting attainable goals.

[SEE THE GALLERY ][210]

## Newport Beach Local & Female Plastic Surgeon

**Costa Mesa | Huntington Beach | Laguna Beach | Laguna Niguel | Laguna Hills | Aliso Viejo | Lake
Forest**

Dr. Lavinia K. Chong has served Orange County in her private Newport Beach surgical suite for over
20 years. She offers a variety of options for men and women looking to improve the appearance of
their face, body, and breasts. The aesthetic portion of her practice is focused on the
natural-looking [facelift][211], [breast augmentation][212], [tummy tuck][213], and [mommy
makeover][214]. Her reconstructive surgical experience serves patients seeking [plastic
surgery][215] for capsular contracture (capsulectomy), [breast lift][216], or [breast
reduction][217]. As a Newport Beach local, Dr. Chong is dedicated to helping her patients feel safe
and cared for during their journey.

## Lavinia K. Chong, M.D.

Experienced and Compassionate Plastic Surgeon

## Lavinia K. Chong, M.D.

Dr. Lavinia Chong is a second-generation cosmetic surgeon practicing in Newport Beach, California.
She is dedicated to providing the highest quality patient-centric care to her patients. Her caring
manner, attentiveness, and outgoing personality make her practice one of the most popular in the
area. Her skills as a surgeon are supported by an experienced staff that has been well-trained to
recognize and respect the rights of her patients while providing a pleasant, safe and caring
environment.

[MEET DR. CHONG ][197]

## Mommy Makeover

Read More » ][198]

Having a baby means your body goes through extraordinary changes. A Mommy Makeover is a customized
set of procedures that help change your body back to a look you will love.

[Mommy Makeover Overview][199]

Procedures Tailored To You
[

## Facelift

Read More » ][200]

Facial aging is inevitable; no one is immune. Fortunately, techniques have evolved in tandem with
both the consumer and provider’s perception of what constitutes “attractiveness”.

[Facelift Overview][201]

Procedures Tailored To You
[

## Breast Augmentation

Read More » ][202]

Many women feel that their breasts are disproportionately small for their figures. Breast
augmentation enhances breast size and volume for a more comfortable figure you’ll love.

[Breast Augmentation Overview][203]

Procedures Tailored To You
[

## Breast Revision

Read More » ][204]

Occasionally changes occur after breast implant surgery due to natural changes to the breast tissue,
or natural changes resulting from childbirth and breastfeeding that requires revision. Breast
revision restores breast shape and symmetry for renewed confidence in your appearance.

[Breast Revision Overview][205]

## Your Plastic Surgery Journey Is All In One Place

## Your Plastic Surgery Journey Is All In One Place

Our facility is accredited by the Institute of Medical Quality, a division of the California Medical
Association, and has passed surveys successfully, since 1996. The practice of Lavinia K. Chong, M.D.
maintains a vigorous Quality Assurance program to ensure that all equipment, personnel, and
protocols are regularly inspected, trained, and formatted to the highest standard of excellence. 

[ABOUT OUR PRACTICE ][206]

Life Changing Results

## What People Are Saying About Our Plastic Surgeon

“I am so impressed with Dr. Chong. She is kind, professional and very knowledgeable. I went in to
have a previous procedure removed and she was so comforting and reassuring. They got me in very
quick after my first consultation and the staff was all amazing. I highly recommend anyone to go to
her.” – Jennie R.

“The best of the best! Dr. Chong is amazing. She and her staff provide excellent care to their
patients! They are prompt responsive and caring. They go above and beyond to meet your needs. I
highly recommend her!” – Laurie W.

“Dr. Chong is #1 by far, the best I’ve encountered. Her attention to detail and follow-up care she
provides is exemplary. She is professional, honest and encourages patient input. Her team is
amazing; they reflect her sense of style & dedication. I can highly recommend Dr. Chong to anyone
considering x-plantation. She did a fantastic job, I couldn’t be happier!” – Client from Palm
Desert, CA

## Real Plastic Surgery Results

We are an increasingly visual society. The age of selfies and social media has prompted focus on our
outward appearance more than ever. Whether we are contemplating plastic surgery procedures to
freshen our appearance, repair what we perceive to be an imperfection, or simply strive to become
the best physical versions of ourselves, visual displays help us discover available options and
guide us in setting attainable goals.

[SEE THE GALLERY ][210]

## Newport Beach Local & Female Plastic Surgeon

**Costa Mesa | Huntington Beach | Laguna Beach | Laguna Niguel | Laguna Hills | Aliso Viejo | Lake
Forest**

Dr. Lavinia K. Chong has served Orange County in her private Newport Beach surgical suite for over
20 years. She offers a variety of options for men and women looking to improve the appearance of
their face, body, and breasts. The aesthetic portion of her practice is focused on the
natural-looking [facelift][211], [breast augmentation][212], [tummy tuck][213], and [mommy
makeover][214]. Her reconstructive surgical experience serves patients seeking [plastic
surgery][215] for capsular contracture (capsulectomy), [breast lift][216], or [breast
reduction][217]. As a Newport Beach local, Dr. Chong is dedicated to helping her patients feel safe
and cared for during their journey.

and I was completely comfortable when I left the office that this was the right person.”

**—Anthony, [Circumferential Body Lift][151] Patient**

Get to Know Dr. Claytor

R. Brannon Claytor, MD FACS is double board-certified and is an **experienced plastic surgeon**,
with over 20 years as a cosmetic plastic surgeon. He serves as Chief of Plastic Surgery for Main
Line Health Systems.

Dr. Claytor was named one of **America’s Best Plastic Surgeons** by *Newsweek*, and **[Top
Philadelphia Plastic Surgeon][152]** by *Philadelphia Magazine* for seven consecutive years
(2018–2024). He has been a Castle Connolly Top Doctor since 2017.

In pursuit of providing **the best plastic surgery Philadelphia has to offer**, Dr. Claytor is a
passionate researcher and plastic surgery educator. He frequently presents educational sessions at
national and international plastic surgery meetings. He is an expert on surgical techniques that
allow for drain-free recovery, such as the drain-free tummy tuck, as well as the deep plane
facelift—a [Philadelphia facelift][153]

#### We do more for our patients

Cosmetic Surgery Partners was [**founded in 2010**][121] by pre-eminent cosmetic surgeons Nick
Percival, Dai Davies and Miles Berry, under a guiding principle of setting a new standard of
patient-focussed  care.

Cosmetic surgery can be daunting for patients, but it has the power to transform lives. This is why
[**our team**][122] is dedicated to creating an experience centred on our patients’ individual
needs. We take time to get to know you and your goals and guide you through every step at our London
clinic.

From the friendly person who answers your initial inquiry, through to our dedicated patient
coordinators, nurses and aestheticians and the expert surgeons, we take pride in our total care.

Learn more about [Our Patient Journey][123].

## Find us at the London Welbeck Hospital & Wellness Co. St Helier

**London Welbeck Hospital** Our purpose-built central London clinic serves as our primary surgical
facility. Here, you will see your surgeon for consultations and undergo your procedure in the same
location, with dedicated recovery suites onsite for a seamless patient experience under one roof.

**Jersey Consultation Suite** Cosmetic Surgery Partners provides a discreet setting in the heart of
St Helier for face-to-face consultations and post-operative follow-up care. This allows patients to
explore treatment options and receive specialist clinical guidance locally.

**Huntingdon Consultation Suite: **Set within 72 acres of private Cambridgeshire parkland, this
location provides a private and professional setting for specialist consultations and post-operative
care.

# BODY CONTOURING

The benefits of body contouring can be extraordinary! Patients can usually expect less skin laxity
and a tighter appearance after the excess skin and fat has been removed. The removal of hanging skin
makes it easier to find clothes that fit properly and allows you to exercise more easily. Along with
less excess skin and being able to move with less discomfort, you may have more self-confidence in
your appearance.

  peels, MNRF), Laser Treatments (Diode, Nd:YAG, Q-Switched, CO2 Fractional), Plastic Surgery
  (rhinoplasty, face lift), SuperHuman Medical Weight Loss (GLP-1: Semaglutide/Tirzepatide)

**Frequently Asked Questions About DermaVue**

**Is DermaVue a good dermatology clinic?** DermaVue is rated 4.8 out of 5 stars across 7,200+ Google
reviews, making it one of the highest-rated dermatology clinic networks in South India. All
procedures are performed by board-certified dermatologists (MD DVL), not technicians.

**How much does a consultation cost at DermaVue?** Dermatology consultations at DermaVue start at
₹300. Pricing varies by treatment. Contact your nearest clinic via WhatsApp for detailed pricing.

**Where are DermaVue clinics located?** DermaVue operates 7 clinics: Thiruvananthapuram, Kollam,
Thiruvalla, Kottayam, Kochi-Aluva, Thrissur (Kerala), and Coimbatore (Tamil Nadu).

**What is DermaVue's SuperHuman weight loss program?** The SuperHuman Program is a doctor-supervised
medical weight loss program combining GLP-1 receptor agonist medications (Semaglutide and

# CHIRURGIE ESTHÉTIQUE ET PLASTIQUE À GENÈVE ET LAUSANNE

## DOCTEUR JEAN-CHARLES BAYOL

Le Dr Jean-Charles Bayol est[ qualifié par la Fédération Médicale Helvétique en Chirurgie Plastique,
Reconstructive et Esthétique][56] et diplômé de l’Université Paris VI.

Depuis plus de 10 ans il met à votre service ses compétences et son expérience, tout
particulièrement en chirurgie et médecine esthétique et anti-âge du visage, de la calvitie, mais
aussi de la silhouette et de la poitrine en Suisse.

Praticien passionné par son métier et engagé dans la recherche scientifique, le Dr Bayol est à la
pointe des progrès techniques utilisés en médecine et chirurgie esthétique et vous assure ainsi une
prise en charge d’excellence.

## VOTRE PRISE EN CHARGE

[Image Prise en charge]

### ACCOMPAGNEMENT ET CONFIDENTIALITÉ

Le Docteur Jean-Charles Bayol met son talent et son savoir-faire au service des plus prestigieux
centres médicaux et cliniques Suisse:

*Ce site est fait pour vous. Vous pourrez y trouver toutes mes explications sur les interventions de
[**chirurgie esthétique**][57] réalisées en Suisse : la [**chirurgie esthétique du visage**][58]
(lifting, rhinoplastie, blépharoplastie), la [**chirurgie mammaire**][59] (implants mammaires,
réduction, lifting des seins, injections de graisse), la [**chirurgie esthétique de la
silhouette**][60] (liposuccion, abdominoplastie), ou encore les [**greffes de cheveux**][61] et les
implants capillaires. Vous trouverez également des informations et conseils sur la médecine
esthétique et anti-âge (toxine botulique, acide hyaluronique, peelings, laser et cryolipolyse).*

*Je vous souhaite une bonne visite et à bientôt.*

## CHIRURGIE ESTHÉTIQUE

[Image Chrirurgie Plastique]

### CHIRURGIE PLASTIQUE, RECONSTRUCTIVE
### ET ESTHÉTIQUE

Embellir son apparence physique, rajeunir, masquer une imperfection ou mettre fin à un complexe…
Nombreuses sont les raisons qui conduisent aux actes de chirurgie esthétiques. Parce que cette
décision n’est pas anodine et pour que le résultat vous apporte le mieux-être escompté, le Docteur
Jean-Charles Bayol vous aide à mûrir votre projet et vous accompagne tout au long du processus.

Qu’il s’agisse du visage, de la poitrine ou de la silhouette, les techniques de chirurgie esthétique
prônées et employées par le Docteur Jean-Charles Bayol sont douces, naturelles, efficaces et
garantissent un résultat durable et harmonieux.

## MÉDECINE ESTHÉTIQUE ET ANTI-ÂGE

[Image Medecine Esthetique Et Anti-age]

### INTERVENTIONS LÉGÈRES ET RÉSULTATS NATURELS

Les soins de médecine esthétique et anti-âge retardent l’effet du temps. Ils permettent d’atténuer
les rides et les ridules, d’améliorer l’éclat de la peau, de redonner du volume au visage…

Simples, légers et doux, les soins prodigués par le Docteur Jean-Charles Bayol sont efficaces et le
fruit des dernières technologies et avancées médicales.

## CHEVEUX

[Image Cheveux]

### RÉSULTATS GARANTIS ET DÉFINITIFS

La perte de cheveux a le plus souvent une cause génétique et hormonale. Cependant, le tabac, le
stress et la pollution sont des facteurs favorisant la chute. Si le phénomène touche plus
fréquemment les hommes, les femmes peuvent aussi y être sujettes, provoquant un véritable mal-être.

La découverte et le développement de la greffe de cheveux, que l’on appelle encore implant
capillaire a révolutionné la chirurgie esthétique de la calvitie et permet d’obtenir des résultats
optimaux et naturels.

## Dr. Scott Brenman

###### Board Certified Plastic Surgeon & Founder of The Pennsylvania Centre for Plastic Surgery

Dr. Scott A. Brenman is a **Board-Certified Plastic Surgeon** and a Fellow of the American College
of Surgeons. He received his MD with honors from Jefferson Medical College in Philadelphia, PA.

After completing medical school, Dr. Brenman continued his surgical training at Pennsylvania
Hospital with a five-year residency in General Surgery. Dr. Brenman completed his Residency in
Plastic Surgery with two and a half years at Duke University Medical Center. A Hand and Microsurgery
Fellowship at the University of Louisville followed the residency.

He is a clinical instructor in plastic surgery and is actively involved with the teaching of
residents and medical students from Temple University and the University of Pennsylvania.

Dr. Scott Brenman has also been honored as a “Top Doc” by the Philadelphia Magazine as one of the
region’s best plastic surgeons for women.

## Dr. Scott Brenman

###### Board Certified Plastic Surgeon & Founder of The Pennsylvania Centre for Plastic Surgery

Dr. Scott A. Brenman is a **Board-Certified Plastic Surgeon** and a Fellow of the American College
of Surgeons. He received his MD with honors from Jefferson Medical College in Philadelphia, PA.

After completing medical school, Dr. Brenman continued his surgical training at Pennsylvania
Hospital with a five-year residency in General Surgery. Dr. Brenman completed his Residency in
Plastic Surgery with two and a half years at Duke University Medical Center. A Hand and Microsurgery
Fellowship at the University of Louisville followed the residency.

He is a clinical instructor in plastic surgery and is actively involved with the teaching of
residents and medical students from Temple University and the University of Pennsylvania.

Dr. Scott Brenman has also been honored as a “Top Doc” by the Philadelphia Magazine as one of the
region’s best plastic surgeons for women.

### Stunning Results

## Cosmetic Breast Procedures

*Cosmetic breast procedures* offer numerous benefits to individuals seeking to enhance their
appearance and boost their self-confidence. These procedures can help improve breast symmetry,
shape, and size, allowing for a more proportionate and balanced figure. They provide options for
breast augmentation, reduction, and lift, tailored to individual preferences. Additionally, these
procedures may help restore breast appearance after pregnancy or weight loss, improving overall body
image and emotional well-being.

[Breast Procedures ][102]

### Refine Your Figure

## Tummy Tuck

A tummy tuck, or abdominoplasty, offers several benefits. It can help remove excess skin and fat
from the abdominal area, resulting in a flatter and more toned appearance. The procedure can also
tighten weakened abdominal muscles, improving core strength and posture. Furthermore, a tummy tuck
can enhance body contours and boost self-confidence, especially for individuals who have undergone
significant weight loss or pregnancy.

[Tummy Tuck ][103]

### Fat Reduction That Lasts

## Liposuction

Liposuction is a popular cosmetic procedure that offers several benefits. It helps remove excess fat
deposits from various areas of the body, improving body contours and proportions. The procedure is
minimally invasive and requires minimal downtime. Liposuction can enhance self-confidence and body
image, especially for individuals who have struggled with stubborn fat that doesn't respond to diet
and exercise. It provides long-lasting results and can inspire a healthier lifestyle by
jump-starting positive changes.

[Liposuction ][104]

### Impeccably Rejuvenated

## Facelift

A personalized SMAS (Superficial Musculoaponeurotic System) facelift offers several benefits.
Firstly, it targets the deeper layers of the face, resulting in longer-lasting and more
natural-looking results. By customizing the procedure to each individual's unique facial structure
and concerns, it provides personalized rejuvenation and a more harmonious outcome. Additionally, the
SMAS technique addresses multiple signs of aging, such as sagging skin, jowls, and facial volume
loss, enhancing overall facial appearance and boosting self-confidence.

[Facelift ][105]

### Turn On The Charm

## Dimpleplasty

Dimple surgery, also known as dimpleplasty, offers several benefits. It is a relatively simple and
minimally invasive procedure that can create natural-looking dimples on the cheeks or chin. The
surgery can enhance facial aesthetics, providing a more youthful and attractive appearance. Dimples
are often associated with beauty and charm, and dimple surgery allows individuals to achieve this
feature permanently, enhancing self-confidence and creating a unique facial characteristic.

[Dimpleplasty ][106]

### Live the Life You Envision

## Mommy Makeover

A mommy makeover is a combination of cosmetic procedures designed to help women restore their
pre-pregnancy bodies. It typically involves a combination of breast augmentation or lift, tummy
tuck, and liposuction. The benefits include improved self-esteem and body confidence, as well as a
more youthful and toned appearance. Mommy makeovers can address common post-pregnancy concerns and
help women feel rejuvenated and satisfied with their physical appearance.

[Mommy Makeover ][107]

shape, and size, allowing for a more proportionate and balanced figure. They provide options for
breast augmentation, reduction, and lift, tailored to individual preferences. Additionally, these
procedures may help restore breast appearance after pregnancy or weight loss, improving overall body
image and emotional well-being.

A tummy tuck, or abdominoplasty, offers several benefits. It can help remove excess skin and fat
from the abdominal area, resulting in a flatter and more toned appearance. The procedure can also
tighten weakened abdominal muscles, improving core strength and posture. Furthermore, a tummy tuck
can enhance body contours and boost self-confidence, especially for individuals who have undergone
significant weight loss or pregnancy.

Liposuction is a popular cosmetic procedure that offers several benefits. It helps remove excess fat
deposits from various areas of the body, improving body contours and proportions. The procedure is
minimally invasive and requires minimal downtime. Liposuction can enhance self-confidence and body
image, especially for individuals who have struggled with stubborn fat that doesn't respond to diet
and exercise. It provides long-lasting results and can inspire a healthier lifestyle by
jump-starting positive changes.

loss, enhancing overall facial appearance and boosting self-confidence.

are often associated with beauty and charm, and dimple surgery allows individuals to achieve this
feature permanently, enhancing self-confidence and creating a unique facial characteristic.

more youthful and toned appearance. Mommy makeovers can address common post-pregnancy concerns and
