## Common Concerns

[
Post-Pregnancy
A post-pregnancy or “mommy makeover” restores the body’s shape and tone after childbirth through
personalized surgical and non-surgical rejuvenation.
Learn More
][60]
[
Chin & Jawline Definition
A well-defined chin and jawline create balance and strength in facial features, enhancing the
harmony between the lower face and profile.
Learn More
][61]
[
Nose Shape & Profile Balance
Concerns about nose shape and profile balance often arise from structural irregularities or
aesthetic proportions that feel out of harmony with the rest of the face.
Learn More
][62]
[
Ageing or Puffy Eyes
Ageing or puffy eyes can create a tired appearance, often caused by changes in skin elasticity, fat
distribution, or fluid retention around the eyes.
Learn More
][63]
[
Breast Size & Shape
Concerns about breast size and shape are common and may arise from genetics, aging, pregnancy, or
changes in weight over time.
Learn More
][64]
[
Excess / Loose Skin
Excess or loose skin often remains after significant weight loss, affecting comfort, confidence, and
body contour.
Learn More
][65]
[
Localised Body Fat
Localised body fat refers to stubborn pockets of fat that remain resistant to diet and exercise,
often affecting body contour and proportion.
Learn More
][66]
[
Double Chin / Submental Fullness
A double chin, or submental fullness, occurs when excess fat or skin gathers beneath the jawline,
softening facial definition.
Learn More
][67]
[
Skin Laxity & Sagging
Skin laxity and sagging occur when the skin loses its firmness and elasticity, leading to a less
defined, aged appearance.
Learn More
][68]
[
Volume Loss / Hollowing
Volume loss and facial hollowing occur as the skin and underlying tissues lose fullness, leading to
a more tired or aged appearance.
Learn More
][69]

# Cosmetic Surgery Manchester Beauty Defined

Dr Mounir has been dedicated to cosmetic surgery and skin health for over 20 years. He is a fully
accredited specialist consultant plastic surgeon on the General Medical Council’s specialist
register for plastic surgery. He specialises in cosmetic Breast Augmentation, Breast Reduction
surgery, Liposuction and Abdominoplasty or the so-called Tummy tuck surgery.


Dr Mounir is a former plastic surgery doctor in the NHS at the Countess of Chester and Honorary
fellow at the Burney Breast Unit, which is located at St Helens Hospital. Dr Mounir latest
scientific publications were about breast cosmetic surgery and Nose reshaping. He has been invited
as speaker in different international cosmetic congress meeting.


Dr Mounir offers the full range of cosmetic procedures including skin rejuvenation using chemical
peeling. He is constantly modernising his techniques and improving patient results. He also accepts
patients from around the world for breast cosmetic revision when surgery carried out elsewhere has
not achieved the desired effect.

# Boost your confidence with expert in breast oncological, reconstructive and aesthetic surgery

Dr. Nadine Moussallem is a dedicated general and breast surgeon with a genuine concern for patient
well-being with over 13 years of quality experience with leading hospitals in Lebanon.

She is a general surgeon practicing since 2011 at Rassoul Al Aazam hospital, Bekhazi hospital,
Bahman hospital, Hayek hospital, Sahel hospital, Beirut. Even though her specialty covers the entire
digestive and endocrine system, Dr. Nadine has a special interest in breast reconstructive and
aesthetic surgeries.

#### Our Mission

Our clinic is dedicated to provide safe, effective, and advanced options for general, aesthetic and
breast surgeries.

We offer aesthetic surgeries for women seeking for a female surgical team.

We offer breast reconstruction using advanced surgical techniques, providing a natural alternative
for patients experiencing breast cancer.

To explore the best options for your needs, contact us today to schedule a personalized consultation
with our expert surgical team.

#### Where Beauty Meets Wellness

Our treatments go deeper than appearance—they’re designed to improve your comfort, restore function,
and enhance your overall quality of life.

Whether you’re recovering from surgery, correcting a medical concern, or seeking balance after
weight loss or childbirth, we focus on holistic results that reflect your true self—inside and out.

With decades of experience, we place honesty and patient trust at the core of everything we
do—ensuring every treatment is guided by integrity and medical excellence.

We care for the whole person, offering compassionate support before, during, and after surgery to

Every procedure is performed with precision and care, enhancing your natural beauty while

  Founded in 2015, by Dr. Janet Denlinger, Morgan Hare, and Dr. Rod Rohrich, AiRS is an advocate for
  restorative breast surgery, a vital part of total physical and emotional healing for many breast
  cancer survivors.
  
  [[The Alliance in Reconstructive Surgery]][88]
* ## [Breast Augmentation][89]
  
  Breast augmentation and breast lift surgery can help enhance the size, shape, symmetry, and
  generally help to balance body proportions. Dr. Rohrich works closely with his patients to give
  the widest selection of possible breast implants shapes and materials, incision locations, and
  implant placement options that work best for each person’s unique situation. This includes use of
  silicone gel breast implants and saline breast implants, with subglandular (prepectoral) or
  subpectoral placements and a wide variety of options to minimize the incision. Dr. Rohrich is also
  a founding member of the AiRS Foundation, a non-profit organization dedicated to helping women
  obtain breast reconstruction after mastectomy.

### Mommy Makeover

Pregnancy can have a dramatic and permanent effect on a woman’s body. We can help improve her
figure, particularly after the impact of multiple pregnancies. With advancements in monitoring,
anesthesia, and medication, we can combine surgeries for a swift recovery. Our children are our
greatest gifts but the extremes of pregnancy can take a toll on the body.
[ Mommy Makeover ][147]

### Liposuction

In today’s image-focused society, maintaining a trim waistline is highly valued. While there are
effective ways of obtaining this slim form – dieting, exercise, and other such mundane chores which
require significant commitment there are surgical methods available as well which are just as
effective for ensuring that you’re ready for beach season.
[ Liposuction ][148]
Body contouring plastic surgery procedures remove excess skin and fat from the belly, thighs, and
arms. By improving the texture and shape of the remaining tissue, Dr. Schusterman can sculpt your
body to match your self-image. Whether you wish to regain your pre-pregnancy figure or if you just
want to look better in a swimsuit, body contouring plastic surgery can help!

### Breast Augmentation

Breast Augmentation or augmentation mammoplasty enhances the size and shape of your breasts using a
breast implant or fat transfer. Breast augmentation can provide you with fuller and more shapely
breasts, as well as improve breast volume and increase your self-confidence.
[ Breast Augmentation ][149]

### Breast Lift

A breast lift surgery can improve contour and balance breast size irregularities. Also known as
mastopexy, a breast lift reshapes and firms the breast by removing excess skin to deliver lift and a
younger-looking profile to your breasts.
[ Breast Lift ][150]

### Breast Reduction

Many women suffer from back problems and many have self-confidence diminished due to having large
breasts that are not proportionate to the frame of their body. Improves self-confidence with a body
contour that delivers a balanced physique.
[ Breast Reduction ][151]
Our medical team has a long history of experience with breast enhancement procedures, from breast
reductions or breast reconstruction due to medical necessity to several methods of breast
augmentation, reshaping, and breast lifting for full and natural bust size.
* Facelift

### Facelift

Facelift surgery reduces the appearance of folds, wrinkles, and loose skin that result from aging.
While it won’t stop the aging process, a facelift can help turn back the clock by addressing
sagging, deep creases, loss of muscle tone, jowls, and double chin. Dr. Schusterman utilizes your
natural features to enhance your new look.

### Mommy Makeover

Pregnancy can have a dramatic and permanent effect on a woman’s body. We can help improve her
figure, particularly after the impact of multiple pregnancies. With advancements in monitoring,
anesthesia, and medication, we can combine surgeries for a swift recovery. Our children are our
greatest gifts but the extremes of pregnancy can take a toll on the body.
[ Mommy Makeover ][147]

### Liposuction

In today’s image-focused society, maintaining a trim waistline is highly valued. While there are
effective ways of obtaining this slim form – dieting, exercise, and other such mundane chores which
require significant commitment there are surgical methods available as well which are just as
effective for ensuring that you’re ready for beach season.
[ Liposuction ][148]
Body contouring plastic surgery procedures remove excess skin and fat from the belly, thighs, and
arms. By improving the texture and shape of the remaining tissue, Dr. Schusterman can sculpt your
body to match your self-image. Whether you wish to regain your pre-pregnancy figure or if you just
want to look better in a swimsuit, body contouring plastic surgery can help!
* Breast Augmentation
* Breast Lift
* Breast Reduction

### Breast Augmentation

Breast Augmentation or augmentation mammoplasty enhances the size and shape of your breasts using a
breast implant or fat transfer. Breast augmentation can provide you with fuller and more shapely
breasts, as well as improve breast volume and increase your self-confidence.
[ Breast Augmentation ][149]

### Breast Lift

A breast lift surgery can improve contour and balance breast size irregularities. Also known as
mastopexy, a breast lift reshapes and firms the breast by removing excess skin to deliver lift and a
younger-looking profile to your breasts.
[ Breast Lift ][150]

### Breast Reduction

Many women suffer from back problems and many have self-confidence diminished due to having large
breasts that are not proportionate to the frame of their body. Improves self-confidence with a body
contour that delivers a balanced physique.
[ Breast Reduction ][151]
Our medical team has a long history of experience with breast enhancement procedures, from breast
reductions or breast reconstruction due to medical necessity to several methods of breast
augmentation, reshaping, and breast lifting for full and natural bust size.
* Facelift
* Blepharoplasty

### Facelift

Facelift surgery reduces the appearance of folds, wrinkles, and loose skin that result from aging.
While it won’t stop the aging process, a facelift can help turn back the clock by addressing
sagging, deep creases, loss of muscle tone, jowls, and double chin. Dr. Schusterman utilizes your
natural features to enhance your new look.

# Sergio Zamora, MD, FACS

### Board Certified Plastic Surgeon

Welcome to the practice of Dr. Sergio M. Zamora, MD, FACS, where compassionate care meets
exceptional skill and experience. Dr. Zamora, a board-certified plastic surgeon and Fellow of the
American College of Surgeons, has dedicated his career to helping patients in Daytona Beach, New
Smyrna Beach, and surrounding Florida communities achieve their aesthetic goals with results that
are natural-looking and refined.

With a comprehensive medical background, Dr. Zamora’s expertise spans both surgical procedures and
medical spa treatments. His extensive training includes a plastic surgery residency at the
University of Utah, where he served as Chief Resident, along with a general surgery residency and
research fellowship at the University of South Carolina’s Richland Memorial Hospital. Dr. Zamora’s
journey in medicine began with earning his Doctor of Medicine degree from the Autonomous University
of Guadalajara, Mexico.

Dr. Zamora’s approach combines precision, artistry, and an unwavering commitment to patient safety
and comfort. He carefully designs each treatment plan to achieve results that enhance your natural
beauty without appearing artificial. At his practice, you will find a calming and discreet
environment where patient satisfaction and ethical medical care are paramount.

# Sergio Zamora, MD, FACS

### Board Certified Plastic Surgeon

Welcome to the practice of Dr. Sergio M. Zamora, MD, FACS, where compassionate care meets
exceptional skill and experience. Dr. Zamora, a board-certified plastic surgeon and Fellow of the
American College of Surgeons, has dedicated his career to helping patients in Daytona Beach, New
Smyrna Beach, and surrounding Florida communities achieve their aesthetic goals with results that
are natural-looking and refined.

With a comprehensive medical background, Dr. Zamora’s expertise spans both surgical procedures and
medical spa treatments. His extensive training includes a plastic surgery residency at the
University of Utah, where he served as Chief Resident, along with a general surgery residency and
research fellowship at the University of South Carolina’s Richland Memorial Hospital. Dr. Zamora’s
journey in medicine began with earning his Doctor of Medicine degree from the Autonomous University
of Guadalajara, Mexico.

Dr. Zamora’s approach combines precision, artistry, and an unwavering commitment to patient safety
and comfort. He carefully designs each treatment plan to achieve results that enhance your natural
beauty without appearing artificial. At his practice, you will find a calming and discreet
environment where patient satisfaction and ethical medical care are paramount.

## Concepts

FAC Centers for Aesthetic Medicine is proud to have been serving the Orange County and Los Angeles
area since 1980. FAC is an award-winning cosmetic surgery center with our double-board certified
facial plastic and plastic surgeons who are exclusively trained in facial, breast, and body plastic
surgery. Facial plastic surgery, which includes a facelift, micro-lifts, browlift, blepharoplasty,
rhinoplasty, otoplasty, and “Mommy Makeovers,” are some of the core competencies of our surgical
team.

[About the practice][80]

Face procedures

## Facial Plastic Surgery

FAC Centers for Aesthetic Medicine is the premier practice in Orange County for facial plastic
surgery. With over two decades of experience, the practice pairs innovation with experience. Every
procedure, whether it be a facelift, rhinoplasty, eyelid surgery, or even non-surgical treatments,
is expertly performed by some of the top aesthetic artists in the country. The procedures performed
at our practice are individually tailored to fit the patient’s unique needs. There is a reason why
thousands of patients have chosen FAC for facial plastic surgery, and we hope to help you achieve a
youthful, refined, and refreshed appearance.

achieve long-lasting results that will improve symmetry and improve facial balance.

[ [home-botox]

### BOTOX® & Neuromodulators

BOTOX® and Neuromodulators are popular, non-surgical treatments designed to smooth out wrinkles and
fine lines. They target areas like crow’s feet, frown lines, and forehead wrinkles, offering a more
youthful, refreshed appearance. These treatments are quick, with minimal downtime, allowing you to
return to your daily activities right away. Our experienced team will work with you to create a
personalized plan that delivers the most natural and effective results. Discover how BOTOX® and
neuromodulators can enhance your look today!

][88]
[ [homepage-dermal-filler]

### Dermal Fillers

Dermal fillers at FAC Centers for Aesthetic Medicine offer clients a quick and effective solution to
restore volume to their faces and smooth out pesky wrinkles. These treatments can enhance lips, lift
sagging cheeks, and soften fine lines, giving you that refreshed, youthful appearance you’ve been
looking for. Our team customizes every filler treatment to your unique goals for a personalized
approach with minimal downtime. If you’re ready to restore your facial volume and smooth wrinkles
for a rejuvenated, natural look, call our office!

][89]
[ [home-fillers]

### Lip Fillers

Lip fillers are a fantastic way to perfect your lips by adding volume, shape, and definition for a
fuller, more youthful look. Whether you’re looking for subtle enhancements or a more dramatic
change, our lip fillers provide a customizable solution. At Facial Aesthetic Concepts, we use
high-quality dermal fillers to achieve natural, smooth results tailored to your unique features. The
treatment is a quick in-and-out session with minimal downtime and delivers noticeable results that
can boost your confidence and leave you with beautifully enhanced lips.

][90]
[ [home-rhinoplasty]

### Liquid Rhinoplasty

Liquid rhinoplasty is a non-surgical option for enhancing the shape of your nose with minimal
downtime. Using our injectable fillers, we can smooth out bumps, lift the tip, and improve the
symmetry of your nose for a more refined profile. At Facial Aesthetic Concepts in Orange County, our
experts carefully customize each treatment to match your natural features, ensuring subtle,
beautiful results. It’s an effective way to reshape your nose without surgery or a lengthy recovery
period.

Laser Treatments

## Skin & Laser Treatments

Our skin and laser treatments effectively rejuvenate your complexion and address a variety of skin
concerns. From acne scars to sun damage, our advanced lasers target and treat imperfections for
smoother, more youthful skin. At Facial Aesthetic Concepts, we promise the latest technology so we
can offer personalized treatments with optimal results and minimal downtime. Whether you’re looking
to reduce wrinkles, tighten skin, or improve texture, our experts are here to help you achieve
glowing, healthy skin.

[Skin & Laser Treatments][96]

[skin-laser-v2]
* [Surface Renewal & Infusion][97]
* [Chemical Peels][98]
* [Microdermabrasion][99]

Medical Skin care

## Skin Care & Spa Services

Aesthetic skin care is the foundation of healthy, radiant skin. At Facial Aesthetic Concepts, we
offer our clients a range of customized treatments to address their skin’s unique needs, from deep
hydration to anti-aging solutions. Our expert team uses medical-grade products and techniques to
improve skin tone, texture, and overall appearance. From tackling fine lines to achieving that
youthful glow, our treatments are designed to help you achieve beautiful, healthy skin. Let us help
you reveal your best skin yet.

[Aesthetic skin care][100]

[skin-aesthetics-v2]

Body procedures

## Breast & Body Surgery

FAC Centers for Aesthetic Medicine offers a range of body-enhancing procedures tailored to your
needs. Our services include breast augmentation, breast lift, and breast reduction with fat
transfer, as well as liposuction and tummy tucks. We also specialize in mommy makeovers and Renuvion
skin tightening to restore a youthful, sculpted appearance. Our team is dedicated to delivering
natural, long-lasting results with personalized care. Let us help you look and feel your best with a
customized approach.

[Breast & body][101]
* [Fat Transfer][102]
* [Tummy Tuck][103]
* [Liposuction][104]
* [Renuvion Skin Tightening][105]
* [Breast Reduction][106]

Natural & Restorative

## Hair Restoration

FAC Centers for Aesthetic Medicine provides advanced hair restoration treatments to restore natural
hair. Our clients have the most effective solutions for thinning or hair loss, with options like
hair transplant surgery, exosome therapy, and PRF hair treatment. These treatments are tailored to
meet their individual needs and deliver natural-looking, long-lasting results. Our skilled team of
experts promises the best care to enhance your appearance and confidence.

[View all hair][107]

[ [hair-transplant]

### Hair Transplant

At FAC Centers for Aesthetic Medicine, we offer an innovative hair transplant to help restore your
natural hairline. This advanced, minimally invasive technique uses automated FUE technology for
precise, scar-free results. Our hair surgery provides a quicker recovery compared to traditional
methods, allowing you to return to daily life sooner. The procedure is tailored to each patient’s
needs for a personalized and effective approach. With a hair transplant, our clients can enjoy
fuller, thicker hair with the long-lasting results they’re looking for.

][108]
[ [hair-treatment]

### PRF Hair Treatment

Revitalize your hair with PRF hair treatment at Facial Aesthetic Concepts. This advanced,
non-surgical procedure uses your body’s own growth factors to stimulate hair follicles and promote
natural hair regrowth. PRF helps enhance scalp health, thicken hair, and combat thinning. Safe and
effective with minimal downtime, it’s an excellent choice for those looking to restore volume and
vitality. Experience the benefits of this innovative treatment and rejuvenate your hair with the
expertise of our skilled team.

][109]
[ [hair-exosomes]

### Exosomes

Exosomes are a groundbreaking hair restoration treatment offered at Facial Aesthetic Concepts. These
microscopic particles, packed with growth factors, rejuvenate the scalp and stimulate hair follicles
for improved growth. Exosome therapy enhances hair thickness, density, and vitality by activating
dormant follicles. This advanced treatment offers clients a noninvasive solution for a fuller,
healthier head of hair. Unlock the potential of Exosome therapy at Facial Aesthetic Concepts and
rejuvenate your hair.

][110]

## Concepts

FAC Centers for Aesthetic Medicine is proud to have been serving the Orange County and Los Angeles
area since 1980. FAC is an award-winning cosmetic surgery center with our double-board certified
facial plastic and plastic surgeons who are exclusively trained in facial, breast, and body plastic
surgery. Facial plastic surgery, which includes a facelift, micro-lifts, browlift, blepharoplasty,
rhinoplasty, otoplasty, and “Mommy Makeovers,” are some of the core competencies of our surgical
team.

[About the practice][80]

Face procedures

## Facial Plastic Surgery

FAC Centers for Aesthetic Medicine is the premier practice in Orange County for facial plastic
surgery. With over two decades of experience, the practice pairs innovation with experience. Every
procedure, whether it be a facelift, rhinoplasty, eyelid surgery, or even non-surgical treatments,
is expertly performed by some of the top aesthetic artists in the country. The procedures performed
at our practice are individually tailored to fit the patient’s unique needs. There is a reason why
thousands of patients have chosen FAC for facial plastic surgery, and we hope to help you achieve a
youthful, refined, and refreshed appearance.

Non-surgical

## Injectables

FAC Centers for Aesthetic Medicine offers a variety of injectables to enhance the patient’s
natural beauty. As leaders in aesthetics and pioneers in facial plastic surgery, we understand the
complexity of facial aging. Our highly trained team designs treatments with every patient’s unique
goals in mind. Be it BOTOX to smooth out fine lines and wrinkles, or dermal fillers to provide a
more youthful appearance and add volume where age may have stolen it away, we’ll work with you to
achieve long-lasting results that will improve symmetry and improve facial balance.

[View all Injectables][87]

[ [home-botox]

### BOTOX® & Neuromodulators

BOTOX® and Neuromodulators are popular, non-surgical treatments designed to smooth out wrinkles and
fine lines. They target areas like crow’s feet, frown lines, and forehead wrinkles, offering a more
youthful, refreshed appearance. These treatments are quick, with minimal downtime, allowing you to
return to your daily activities right away. Our experienced team will work with you to create a
personalized plan that delivers the most natural and effective results. Discover how BOTOX® and
neuromodulators can enhance your look today!

][88]
[ [homepage-dermal-filler]

### Dermal Fillers

Dermal fillers at FAC Centers for Aesthetic Medicine offer clients a quick and effective solution to
restore volume to their faces and smooth out pesky wrinkles. These treatments can enhance lips, lift
sagging cheeks, and soften fine lines, giving you that refreshed, youthful appearance you’ve been
looking for. Our team customizes every filler treatment to your unique goals for a personalized
approach with minimal downtime. If you’re ready to restore your facial volume and smooth wrinkles
for a rejuvenated, natural look, call our office!

][89]
[ [home-fillers]

### Lip Fillers

Lip fillers are a fantastic way to perfect your lips by adding volume, shape, and definition for a
fuller, more youthful look. Whether you’re looking for subtle enhancements or a more dramatic
change, our lip fillers provide a customizable solution. At Facial Aesthetic Concepts, we use
high-quality dermal fillers to achieve natural, smooth results tailored to your unique features. The
treatment is a quick in-and-out session with minimal downtime and delivers noticeable results that
can boost your confidence and leave you with beautifully enhanced lips.

][90]
[ [home-rhinoplasty]

### Liquid Rhinoplasty

Liquid rhinoplasty is a non-surgical option for enhancing the shape of your nose with minimal
downtime. Using our injectable fillers, we can smooth out bumps, lift the tip, and improve the
symmetry of your nose for a more refined profile. At Facial Aesthetic Concepts in Orange County, our
experts carefully customize each treatment to match your natural features, ensuring subtle,
beautiful results. It’s an effective way to reshape your nose without surgery or a lengthy recovery
period.

## Skin & Laser Treatments

Our skin and laser treatments effectively rejuvenate your complexion and address a variety of skin
concerns. From acne scars to sun damage, our advanced lasers target and treat imperfections for
smoother, more youthful skin. At Facial Aesthetic Concepts, we promise the latest technology so we
can offer personalized treatments with optimal results and minimal downtime. Whether you’re looking
to reduce wrinkles, tighten skin, or improve texture, our experts are here to help you achieve
glowing, healthy skin.

## Skin Care & Spa Services

Aesthetic skin care is the foundation of healthy, radiant skin. At Facial Aesthetic Concepts, we
offer our clients a range of customized treatments to address their skin’s unique needs, from deep
hydration to anti-aging solutions. Our expert team uses medical-grade products and techniques to
improve skin tone, texture, and overall appearance. From tackling fine lines to achieving that
youthful glow, our treatments are designed to help you achieve beautiful, healthy skin. Let us help
you reveal your best skin yet.

Body procedures

## Breast & Body Surgery

FAC Centers for Aesthetic Medicine offers a range of body-enhancing procedures tailored to your
needs. Our services include breast augmentation, breast lift, and breast reduction with fat
transfer, as well as liposuction and tummy tucks. We also specialize in mommy makeovers and Renuvion
skin tightening to restore a youthful, sculpted appearance. Our team is dedicated to delivering
natural, long-lasting results with personalized care. Let us help you look and feel your best with a
customized approach.

Natural & Restorative

## Hair Restoration

FAC Centers for Aesthetic Medicine provides advanced hair restoration treatments to restore natural
hair. Our clients have the most effective solutions for thinning or hair loss, with options like
hair transplant surgery, exosome therapy, and PRF hair treatment. These treatments are tailored to
meet their individual needs and deliver natural-looking, long-lasting results. Our skilled team of
experts promises the best care to enhance your appearance and confidence.

[View all hair][107]

[ [hair-transplant]

### Hair Transplant

At FAC Centers for Aesthetic Medicine, we offer an innovative hair transplant to help restore your
natural hairline. This advanced, minimally invasive technique uses automated FUE technology for
precise, scar-free results. Our hair surgery provides a quicker recovery compared to traditional
methods, allowing you to return to daily life sooner. The procedure is tailored to each patient’s
needs for a personalized and effective approach. With a hair transplant, our clients can enjoy
fuller, thicker hair with the long-lasting results they’re looking for.

][108]
[ [hair-treatment]

### PRF Hair Treatment

Revitalize your hair with PRF hair treatment at Facial Aesthetic Concepts. This advanced,
non-surgical procedure uses your body’s own growth factors to stimulate hair follicles and promote
natural hair regrowth. PRF helps enhance scalp health, thicken hair, and combat thinning. Safe and
effective with minimal downtime, it’s an excellent choice for those looking to restore volume and
vitality. Experience the benefits of this innovative treatment and rejuvenate your hair with the
expertise of our skilled team.

][109]
[ [hair-exosomes]

### Exosomes

Exosomes are a groundbreaking hair restoration treatment offered at Facial Aesthetic Concepts. These
microscopic particles, packed with growth factors, rejuvenate the scalp and stimulate hair follicles
for improved growth. Exosome therapy enhances hair thickness, density, and vitality by activating
dormant follicles. This advanced treatment offers clients a noninvasive solution for a fuller,
healthier head of hair. Unlock the potential of Exosome therapy at Facial Aesthetic Concepts and
rejuvenate your hair.

][110]

## О клинике

Место, где каждая деталь создана для вашего совершенства

Мы верим, что красота должна отражать индивидуальность. Поэтому ForMe создают не шаблонный
результат, а образ, близкий именно вам. Мы объединили ведущих хирургов, косметологов и флебологов
страны, обеспечив их передовым оборудованием.

Особое внимание — атомсфере: элегантный интерьер, продуманные детали и комфорт соответствуют уровню
премиального сервиса. Клиника занимает 2 200 м² в отдельном здании: 3 современные операционные,
палата пробуждения, 13 палат, 7 кабинетов косметологии и более 10 кабинетов приема.

## О клинике

Место, где каждая деталь создана для вашего совершенства

Мы верим, что красота должна отражать индивидуальность. Поэтому ForMe создают не шаблонный
результат, а образ, близкий именно вам. Мы объединили ведущих хирургов, косметологов и флебологов
страны, обеспечив их передовым оборудованием.

Особое внимание — атомсфере: элегантный интерьер, продуманные детали и комфорт соответствуют уровню
премиального сервиса. Клиника занимает 2 200 м² в отдельном здании: 3 современные операционные,
палата пробуждения, 13 палат, 7 кабинетов косметологии и более 10 кабинетов приема.

### Hasan Surgery

Defining Excellence in Aesthetic Care

To bring his philosophy of patient-first care to life, Dr. Hasan founded Hasan Surgery. Located in
the prestigious Dubai Healthcare City (DHCC) and accredited by the AAAASF since 2016, the clinic is
consistently rated among the top aesthetic centers in the region.

Under Dr. Hasan’s leadership, the clinic serves as a trusted environment specializing in advanced
body contouring, facial rejuvenation, breast surgery, and tailored male aesthetic procedures. By
pairing world-class safety standards with predictable, high-quality outcomes in plastic surgery in
Dubai, Hasan Surgery stands out as a benchmark of professionalism in the crowded landscape of
cosmetic procedures.

[Best Plastic Surgeon in Dubai | Best Cosmetic Surgeon in Dubai - Dr. Hasan Ali]

### Dr. Hasan Ali

The Master of High-Definition Contouring

With over 20 years of international experience and a legacy of more than 10,000 successful
procedures, Dr. Hasan Ali is recognized as one of Dubai’s premier specialist plastic and
reconstructive surgeons. Widely celebrated as a leading authority in VASER Liposuction, Dr. Hasan
has built a reputation for a meticulous, highly detail-oriented surgical approach. His commitment to
blending clinical precision with artful artistry consistently delivers exceptional, transformative
results for a global clientele.

## [Breast Procedures ][115]

Whether performed to enlarge, reduce, or lift the breasts, these procedures can improve the physical
appearance and emotional confidence of all women.
* [ Breast Augmentation ][116]
* [ Breast Lift ][117]
* [ Breast Reduction ][118]
* [ Breast Revision ][119]
* [ Fat Transfer to the Breast ][120]

## [Body Contouring Procedures ][121]

Body contouring procedures reshape your figure by reducing excess fat, tightening skin, and using
the removed fat to increase volume in other body areas.
* [ Tummy Tuck ][122]
* [ Liposuction ][123]
* [ Mommy Makeover ][124]
* [ SmartLipo ][125]
* [ Butt Lift ][126]
* [ Brazilian Butt Lift ][127]
* [ Fat Transfer ][128]
* [ After Weight Loss Surgery ][129]
* [ Arm Lift ][130]
* [ InMode’s BodyTite® ][131]
* [ Labiaplasty / Vaginoplasty ][132]
* [ Lower Body Lift ][133]

> “You cannot focus on one area to make you as beautiful as you can be. You often need several.”
> 
> Dr. Khoobehi

## Offers Personalized Plastic Surgery

**Dr. Khoobehi works to give each patient the results that will best enhance their natural beauty!**
These types of transformation can’t always be accomplished with a single procedure. He listens to
your goals and creates customized, all-encompassing treatment plans to ensure that everything
remains in perfect aesthetic balance and proportion.

Dr. Khoobehi may suggest additional treatment to enhance your shape while creating a more harmonious
and transformative result. He and his team offer surgical and non-surgical procedures to achieve
this objective.

[ View Services ][134]

## [Facial Rejuvenation Procedures ][135]

Aging features and improper facial proportions do not need to simply be accepted. Facial plastic
surgery procedures can restore a more youthful and balanced facial appearance.
* [ Facelift ][136]
* [ Eyelid Surgery ][137]
* [ Brow Lift ][138]
* [ Rhinoplasty ][139]
* [ Revision Rhinoplasty ][140]
* [ Lip Augmentation ][141]

* [ Ear Surgery ][144]

## [Male Plastic Surgery ][145]

Male plastic surgery helps men achieve the same benefits as those achieved by female plastic
surgery, regardless of whether they are targeting the face or the body.
* [ Gynecomastia (Male Breast Reduction Surgery) ][146]
* [ Facelift ][147]
* [ Tummy Tuck ][148]
* [ Liposuction ][149]
* [ SmartLipo ][150]
* [ Fat Transfer ][151]

Advanced Non-Surgical Treatments

Dr. Khoobehi has been instrumental in shaping and bringing forth some of the most performed plastic
surgery techniques used today.

## Non-Surgical Treatments

## Non-surgical Treatments

Non-surgical techniques have advanced significantly and are sometimes a suitable alternative to
surgery for qualifying patients. These treatments are helping to change the face of modern plastic
surgery.
* [ Coolsculpting® ][155]

## Injectables

## Injectables

Now, a broad spectrum of fillers and neuromodulators are available to soften wrinkles and restore
lost facial volume.
* [ BOTOX® Cosmetic ][156]
* [ DAXXIFY® ][157]
* [ JUVÉDERM® ][158]
* [ JUVÉDERM® VOLUMA® XC ][159]
* [ RHA Collection: RHA2/RHA4 ][160]
* [ JUVÉDERM® VOLBELLA® XC ][161]

## Skin Treatments

## Skin Treatments

Facial plastic surgery results will never reach optimal levels without healthy skin. Non-surgical
treatments restore glowing skin tone and texture.
* [ Clear + Brilliant ][162]
* [ Morpheus8™ ][163]
* [ SkinPen® Microneedling ][164]
* [ Fraxel® ][165]
* [ Laser Hair Removal ][166]
* [ Chemical Peel ][167]
* [ DiamondGlow ][168]
* [ e2/ eMatrix™ ][169]
* [ Dermaplaning ][170]
* [ IPL Photo Rejuvenation ][171]
* [ Laser Skin Resurfacing ][172]
* [ Microdermabrasion ][173]

> “I would not offer a procedure to a patient that I wouldn’t offer to my own family.”
> 
> Dr. Khoobehi

## Before & After Photos

See Our Patients’ Transformations for Yourself

[ View Photo Gallery ][174]

Featured Procedures

## Fat Grafting to the Breast

Fat grafting, or Cleavage Therapy, is not about replacing the implants; it is about improving the
quality of your breasts.

Dr. Khoobehi has been instrumental in bringing fat grafting to the breasts to the masses. Fat
transfer enhances the shape and feel of the breasts with a natural look and touch. Fat-grafted
breasts grow and change with you, and they allow you to achieve the feminine curves you want. Dr.
Khoobehi offers fat grafting to the breast alone or in combination with implants, a breast lift, or
breast implant removal.

[ About Fat Grafting (Breast) ][175]

## Facelift Under Local Anesthesia

Many of Dr. Khoobehi’s rejuvenating facelifts are performed in-office under local anesthesia.

Facelift under local anesthesia provides a safer and often more desirable alternative for patients
who don’t want to undergo general anesthesia. Aging is as much about volume loss as it is sagging
tissues; facelift surgery with or without local anesthesia is commonly combined with fat grafting to
the face. This allows Dr. Khoobehi to fill and lift your features for a more natural look and feel
that lasts.

[ About Facelift ][176]

## Mommy Makeover

Motherhood changes your figure in more ways than one. This is why it is important to combine breast
and body contouring techniques.

Dr. Khoobehi’s Mommy Makeover integrates abdominoplasty with lipo 360 (liposuction of the torso’s
circumference) and fat grafting to the hip area to create or restore the desired hourglass figure.
This procedure is about finding the perfect combination of treatments and areas of fat grafting.
Curves come from fat, not bone or muscle, and must be handled delicately.

[ About Mommy Makeover ][177]

## Dr. Kamran Khoobehi

Board-Certified Plastic Surgeon, Pioneer in Fat Grafting, Instructor, and Mentor

Dr. Khoobehi is set apart by the attention to detail he brings to every procedure he performs. He
understands that transformative plastic surgery is more than just excellence in technique; it
requires an innate eye for beauty which cannot be learned. This means that he does not only
visualize how to perfect YOUR body, but he also sees YOU, the person in the body.

Throughout his career, Dr. Khoobehi has received recognition and respect from his patients, peers,
and the plastic surgery community at large. These acknowledgements allowed him to become one of
Newsweek’s Top 50 Plastic Surgeons, a peer-recommended award.

[ Meet Dr. Khoobehi ][114]
[Dr. Khoobehi]

Dr. Khoobehi brings the best combination of experience and skill to his patients in Metairie and the
greater New Orleans community in Louisiana.

## [Body Contouring Procedures ][121]

Body contouring procedures reshape your figure by reducing excess fat, tightening skin, and using
the removed fat to increase volume in other body areas.

## Offers Personalized Plastic Surgery

**Dr. Khoobehi works to give each patient the results that will best enhance their natural beauty!**
These types of transformation can’t always be accomplished with a single procedure. He listens to
your goals and creates customized, all-encompassing treatment plans to ensure that everything
remains in perfect aesthetic balance and proportion.

Dr. Khoobehi may suggest additional treatment to enhance your shape while creating a more harmonious
and transformative result. He and his team offer surgical and non-surgical procedures to achieve
this objective.

Featured Procedures

## Fat Grafting to the Breast

Fat grafting, or Cleavage Therapy, is not about replacing the implants; it is about improving the
quality of your breasts.

Dr. Khoobehi has been instrumental in bringing fat grafting to the breasts to the masses. Fat
transfer enhances the shape and feel of the breasts with a natural look and touch. Fat-grafted
breasts grow and change with you, and they allow you to achieve the feminine curves you want. Dr.
Khoobehi offers fat grafting to the breast alone or in combination with implants, a breast lift, or
breast implant removal.

[ About Fat Grafting (Breast) ][175]

## Facelift Under Local Anesthesia

Many of Dr. Khoobehi’s rejuvenating facelifts are performed in-office under local anesthesia.

Facelift under local anesthesia provides a safer and often more desirable alternative for patients
who don’t want to undergo general anesthesia. Aging is as much about volume loss as it is sagging
tissues; facelift surgery with or without local anesthesia is commonly combined with fat grafting to
the face. This allows Dr. Khoobehi to fill and lift your features for a more natural look and feel
that lasts.

[ About Facelift ][176]

## Mommy Makeover

Motherhood changes your figure in more ways than one. This is why it is important to combine breast
and body contouring techniques.

Dr. Khoobehi’s Mommy Makeover integrates abdominoplasty with lipo 360 (liposuction of the torso’s
circumference) and fat grafting to the hip area to create or restore the desired hourglass figure.
This procedure is about finding the perfect combination of treatments and areas of fat grafting.
Curves come from fat, not bone or muscle, and must be handled delicately.

[ About Mommy Makeover ][177]

MACS clinic is a unique clinic that offers specialised services, which are led by a team of senior
Consultants that have worked extensively in the NHS and private healthcare.
If you are tired of the long waiting lists or are unable to get treatment in your local area, MACS
Clinic offers you the choice to be treated at your convenience.
We believe in providing tailor-made treatment and invite you to explore our personalised services.

###### Our Highlights
* Video consultations offered (free for Cosmetic enquiries) and minimum waiting time for
  investigations and treatments.
* Situated in the heart of Watford city centre.
* Our clinic timings are from 9.30am to 5.30pm on week days and 9am to 5.30pm on Saturdays.
* Walking distance from train stations and car parking facilities.
* CQC registered and outstanding patient reviews.

### Pain Management

Suffering due to the pain is often only appreciated by the patient and the ones who see them in
pain. Unlike many other diseases, people struggle to show why they are in pain as it is a very
subjective and personal experience. We understand this and the Consultants at the Pain Management
Clinic would perform a proper assessment, examination and investigation to arrive at a proposed
diagnosis and provide you with potential pain management strategies problems. Some of the pain
conditions could be completely sorted, most of it can be adequately.

[Read More][111]
[Home]

### Plastic Surgery

**Plastic Surgery** is a surgical specialty that deals with the correction of any congenital,
acquired, tumor or simply involutive process that requires repair or replacement, or that affects
body shape and / or function. Their techniques are based on the transplantation and mobilization of
tissues by means of grafts and flaps or even implants of inert material. Reconstructive Plastic
Surgery seeks to restore or improve function and physical appearance in injuries caused by accidents
and burns, in diseases and tumors of the skin and supporting tissues, and in congenital anomalies,
mainly of the face, hands and genitals.

**Aesthetic Plastic Surgery**, on the other hand, deals with generally healthy patients and its
purpose is to correct alterations in the aesthetic norm in order to obtain greater facial and body
harmony or the sequelae produced by aging. This affects emotional stability, improving the quality
of life through professional and emotional relationships, etc.

[Read More][112]
[Home]

### Cosmetic and aesthetics procedure

MACS Clinic is a renowned destination for individuals seeking top-tier cosmetic and aesthetics
procedures. With a commitment to enhancing natural beauty and boosting self-confidence, our team of

### Pain Management

Suffering due to the pain is often only appreciated by the patient and the ones who see them in
pain. Unlike many other diseases, people struggle to show why they are in pain as it is a very
subjective and personal experience. We understand this and the Consultants at the Pain Management
Clinic would perform a proper assessment, examination and investigation to arrive at a proposed
diagnosis and provide you with potential pain management strategies problems. Some of the pain
conditions could be completely sorted, most of it can be adequately.

[Read More][111]
[Home]

### Plastic Surgery

**Plastic Surgery** is a surgical specialty that deals with the correction of any congenital,
acquired, tumor or simply involutive process that requires repair or replacement, or that affects
body shape and / or function. Their techniques are based on the transplantation and mobilization of
tissues by means of grafts and flaps or even implants of inert material. Reconstructive Plastic
Surgery seeks to restore or improve function and physical appearance in injuries caused by accidents
and burns, in diseases and tumors of the skin and supporting tissues, and in congenital anomalies,
mainly of the face, hands and genitals.

**Aesthetic Plastic Surgery**, on the other hand, deals with generally healthy patients and its
purpose is to correct alterations in the aesthetic norm in order to obtain greater facial and body
harmony or the sequelae produced by aging. This affects emotional stability, improving the quality
of life through professional and emotional relationships, etc.

[Read More][112]
[Home]

### Cosmetic and aesthetics procedure

MACS Clinic is a renowned destination for individuals seeking top-tier cosmetic and aesthetics
procedures. With a commitment to enhancing natural beauty and boosting self-confidence, our team of
skilled professionals employs the latest advancements in cosmetic treatments to deliver exceptional
results.

Whether you’re looking for non-surgical solutions like Botox, dermal fillers, or rejuvenating
facials, or considering more transformative procedures such as facelifts and liposuction, MACS

## Face & Neck Lift in Pittsburgh, PA

When it comes to facial rejuvenation, nothing compares to the power of surgical lifting procedures.
Face and neck lift surgeries remove lax, excess skin and return the underlying volume to its
youthful position. Combining these procedures produces a harmoniously youthful and natural
appearance, turning back the clock by years or even decades. Our renowned surgeons offer the skill
and expertise to deliver exquisite results, allowing you to reclaim firm skin and refined facial
contours that reflect your inner vibrance and vitality.

[Face & Neck Lift][111]

[Rhinoplasty][112]

## Rhinoplasty in Pittsburgh, PA

As a central point on the face, the nose strongly influences facial and profile proportions and
contours. Rhinoplasty is a surgical cosmetic procedure that refines the contours and symmetry of the
nose to enhance facial balance. Each rhinoplasty is designed to address specific concerns in a way
that complements the face’s natural anatomy. Rhinoplasty can effectively reduce the dorsal hump,
reshape the tip, or correct asymmetry in the nose as well as improve airflow for results that are
aesthetically and functionally beautiful.

[Rhinoplasty][113]

[Blepharoplasty][114]

## Blepharoplasty in Pittsburgh, PA

Eyelid surgery (or blepharoplasty) refines the eyelids. Skin laxity, wrinkles and fine lines,
undereye bags, and heavy eyelids can have a substantial impact on the youthfulness of your
appearance. Upper and lower blepharoplasty surgeries eliminate excess skin contributing to signs of
aging or impairing your field of vision to reveal a bright and authentically vibrant look. Through
small, carefully placed incisions, your board-certified surgeon will meticulously restore your eyes’
youthful allure.

When it comes to facial rejuvenation, nothing compares to the power of surgical lifting procedures.
Face and neck lift surgeries remove lax, excess skin and return the underlying volume to its
youthful position. Combining these procedures produces a harmoniously youthful and natural
appearance, turning back the clock by years or even decades. Our renowned surgeons offer the skill
and expertise to deliver exquisite results, allowing you to reclaim firm skin and refined facial
contours that reflect your inner vibrance and vitality.

## Rhinoplasty in Pittsburgh, PA

As a central point on the face, the nose strongly influences facial and profile proportions and
contours. Rhinoplasty is a surgical cosmetic procedure that refines the contours and symmetry of the
nose to enhance facial balance. Each rhinoplasty is designed to address specific concerns in a way
that complements the face’s natural anatomy. Rhinoplasty can effectively reduce the dorsal hump,
reshape the tip, or correct asymmetry in the nose as well as improve airflow for results that are
aesthetically and functionally beautiful.

## Blepharoplasty in Pittsburgh, PA

Eyelid surgery (or blepharoplasty) refines the eyelids. Skin laxity, wrinkles and fine lines,
undereye bags, and heavy eyelids can have a substantial impact on the youthfulness of your
appearance. Upper and lower blepharoplasty surgeries eliminate excess skin contributing to signs of
aging or impairing your field of vision to reveal a bright and authentically vibrant look. Through
small, carefully placed incisions, your board-certified surgeon will meticulously restore your eyes’
youthful allure.

**MediCzech – Excellence in Plastic & Bariatric Surgery**

Medizech offers top-tier plastic and bariatric surgery with years of experience (since 2011) and a

Our services include:

Your transformation starts with us!

## Dr. Di Beckman
## Plastic Surgeon

After receiving her medical degree with honors, [Dr. Beckman][117] was selected for a highly
competitive integrated plastic surgery residency position at Rutgers University, where she
rigorously trained in both aesthetic and complex reconstructive plastic surgery for six years.
During residency, she developed a strong passion for plastic surgery education and research. She
earned several teaching and clinical excellence awards and served as Chief Resident in her final
year.

After residency, Dr. Beckman was selected for an aesthetic plastic surgery fellowship position at
H/K/B Cosmetic Surgery, one of the nation’s premier aesthetic plastic surgery practices. This
additional year gives her the unique opportunity to learn from some of the most recognized names in
aesthetic plastic surgery and to train with the most innovative procedures and products available.

flexibility to choose a payment option that best fits their lifestyle and budget. If you decide to
move forward with surgery, a $1,000 deposit is required to reserve your surgical date, and the
remaining balance is due at your pre-operative appointment, typically one to two weeks before
surgery. There is never a “perfect” time to invest in yourself. If you’ve been considering a breast
augmentation, tummy tuck, facelift, mommy makeover, or another procedure, our team is here to walk
you through your options and help you determine what works best for you. To schedule a consultation,
call or text us at 📲317-848-5512. Financing is subject to credit approval. Terms and promotional
offers vary by provider. #patientfi #cherryfinance #carecredit #plasticsurgery #mommymakeover]

###### About Dr. Sarah A. Cazorla

## Experience and Excellence

Dr Cazorla is an artist at heart. She is able to apply her skill, precision, and artistic eye to
develop a treatment plan that is unique to each of her patients. Her work allows the patient’s
natural beauty to shine through.

As a woman and mother of two she is particularly passionate about helping women redefine their
bodies after childbirth. This “mommy makeover” is a collection of surgical options that can be
taylored to each patient’s specific needs to help restore their bodies.
* Dr. Cazorla is a Board Certified Plastic Surgeon
* Dr. Cazorla is a Fellow of the American College of Surgeons and an active member of the American
  Society of Plastic Surgeons

WHO WE ARE
Newmedical Technology, Inc. is a global medical products company focused on the development,
manufacturing, and distribution of patented therapies for advanced wound care, scar management, and
skin care. We understand both the physical and psychological impact of wounds and the scars they
create and are dedicated to supplying medical professionals with new solutions to improve the
quality of life for patients.
[Learn More][45]
[
AESTHETICS
Our aesthetic products are designed to enhance the patient experience by minimizing scarring and
addressing post-surgical or post-procedure symptoms. They help reduce downtime, promote faster
healing, and improve overall recovery.
Learn More
][46]
ADVANCE WOUND CARE
Our loaded foam dressings encourage and help accelerate wound healing. A superabsorbent polyurethane
foam core and exclusive material components provide superior absorption and retention. Wound
cleansing agents, skin soothing agents and easy release make our products patient and provider
friendly.
[Learn More][47]
[
SURGICAL
We develop surgical aids in response to the needs of surgeons. We design ergonomic products to
improve surgeon comfort and reduce muscle fatigue, improving overall operating room experience.
Learn More
][48]

physicians and patients worldwide."

WHO WE ARE
Newmedical Technology, Inc. is a global medical products company focused on the development,
manufacturing, and distribution of patented therapies for advanced wound care, scar management, and
skin care. We understand both the physical and psychological impact of wounds and the scars they
create and are dedicated to supplying medical professionals with new solutions to improve the
quality of life for patients.
[Learn More][45]
[
AESTHETICS
Our aesthetic products are designed to enhance the patient experience by minimizing scarring and
addressing post-surgical or post-procedure symptoms. They help reduce downtime, promote faster
healing, and improve overall recovery.
Learn More
][46]
ADVANCE WOUND CARE
Our loaded foam dressings encourage and help accelerate wound healing. A superabsorbent polyurethane
foam core and exclusive material components provide superior absorption and retention. Wound
cleansing agents, skin soothing agents and easy release make our products patient and provider
friendly.
[Learn More][47]
[
SURGICAL
We develop surgical aids in response to the needs of surgeons. We design ergonomic products to
improve surgeon comfort and reduce muscle fatigue, improving overall operating room experience.
Learn More
][48]
"We are committed to develop, manufacture and distribute the highest quality products to our
physicians and patients worldwide."
A. Michael Hanna - CEO

### AESTHETICS

Our aesthetic products are designed to enhance the patient experience by minimizing scarring and
addressing post-surgical or post-procedure symptoms.

They help reduce downtime, promote faster healing, and improve overall recovery.

# Plastic Surgery

When the world thinks plastic surgery, they think of Beverly Hills. When the world thinks **Beverly
Hills Plastic Surgery**, they think of the doctors at the Plastic Surgery Institute. Over the years,
our impeccable work has set the standard for ideal plastic surgery results around the globe.

importance and ensure that any changes we make to the face reflect your true self.

Beverly Hills Plastic Surgeons

Ritu Chopra MS, MD

Dr. Ritu Chopra is a board-certified plastic and reconstructive surgeon, highly regarded for his
expertise in advanced facelifts, breast surgeries, and facial rejuvenation. As one of the **most
sought-after plastic surgeons in Beverly Hills**, Dr. Chopra is known for his innovative approach,
particularly his signature [DEFINE Deep-Plane Facelift][114], which delivers natural, long-lasting
results by addressing all aspects of facial aging. His dedication to advancing the field extends to
his role at the Keck Aesthetic Surgery Fellowship at USC, where he trains the *next generation of
plastic surgeons*.

[ @drrituchopra][115] [Dr. Ritu Chopra ][116]

Nathaniel Villanueva MD

Board-certified plastic and reconstructive surgeon Dr. Nathaniel Villanueva is dedicated to helping
patients look and feel their best. He is known for his patient-centered approach, delivering
natural-looking, proportionate results with a focus on safety and wellness. As a leading expert in
the Atlas and Atlantis Advanced Liposuction and Fat Transfer systems, Dr. Villanueva combines
advanced techniques with a deep understanding of each patient's unique anatomy to achieve
exceptional outcomes with minimal recovery time, ensuring enhanced appearance while maintaining
harmony with the body’s natural contours.

[ @drnvplasticsurgery][117] [Dr. Nathaniel Villanueva ][118]

Vikram Mookerjee MD

An Ivy League-educated and fellowship-trained plastic surgeon, Dr. Mookerjee was hand-selected and
mentored by Dr. Chopra to bring elite academic rigor to the Plastic Surgery Institute. He is
well-versed in a comprehensive range of aesthetic procedures, with a specialized focus on his
proprietary Preservation Facelift and submandibular gland reduction for superior jawline contouring.
Combining surgical artistry with deep, grounded empathy, Dr. Mookerjee utilizes a detail oriented
approach to deliver transformative, natural-looking results tailored to your unique goals.

[ @drvikmookerjee][119] [Dr. Vikram Mookerjee ][120]

The Plastic Surgery
Institute MedSpa

We believe that in Beverly Hills, plastic surgery should be clinical without feeling clinical. At
the Plastic Surgery Institute, you can pamper yourself and refresh your look simultaneously with a
wide selection of transformational treatments that will leave you looking and feeling great. When
you are ready to treat yourself with a spa day that restores you for months afterward, book a spa
day at PSI and let our trained professionals refresh your body and mind. Get started by choosing one
of our featured services below.

and Dysport

Deep Plane
Facelift

Dr. Ritu Chopra is proud to offer his signature DEFINE Deep Plane Facelift, a cutting-edge procedure
designed to deliver the most effective and natural-looking facial rejuvenation. The DEFINE Deep
Plane Facelift addresses the deeper structures of the face, lifting the tissues beneath the skin
while preserving the natural integrity of the overlying skin and muscles. This advanced technique
helps achieve a revitalized, youthful appearance without compromising facial harmony.

DEFINE: 

Deep plane
Extended
Facelift
Including

Elevation of brows

The DEFINE Deep Plane Facelift offers several significant advantages over traditional facelift
procedures. Patients benefit from more dynamic and longer-lasting results, achieving a natural and
rejuvenated look. This technique effectively softens nasolabial folds, addresses skin laxity, and
reduces sagging in both the face and neck, while maintaining a recovery period comparable to other
facelift methods. Dr. Chopra has dedicated decades to perfecting this approach, which has set a new
standard in facial rejuvenation and is now taught to surgeons around the globe.

Experience unparalleled body contouring with The Plastic Surgery Institute, where expert surgeons
lead the field in advanced cosmetic procedures. Our Beverly Hills practice is renowned for its
commitment to excellence, blending cutting-edge techniques with personalized, compassionate care to
achieve outstanding results tailored to your unique needs. As educators in the field, our surgeons
not only perform transformative procedures but also guide and mentor other professionals on
achieving optimal outcomes. Discover how we can reshape and enhance your natural contours with
meticulous expertise.

Atlantis Lipo ATLAS Lipo Body Lifts

Atlantis Lipo

With Atlantis, fat can be suctioned away from stubborn parts of the body, revealing the defined
muscle beneath. But why let all that good volume go to waste? Atlantis takes the fat that has been
suctioned away from areas where you don’t want it and places it where it can do some good. Atlantis
can suction fat from the following areas and can then be implanted in the breasts and buttocks to
increase curves. In some cases, the amount of fat transferred can rival that of an implant procedure
- without implants!
* **Abdomen**: Removes stubborn fat pockets and reveals muscle definition
* **Thighs**: Slenderizes and trims saddlebags and flank
* **Arms**: Increases muscle definition and removes unsightly fat
* **Back**: Reduces bulges or unsightly fat deposits

[Atlantis Lipo ][139]

ATLAS Lipo

ATLAS (Anatomically True Lipo Aspiratory Sculpting) a revolutionary liposuction procedure designed
to accentuate muscle — inspired by the mythical hero who carried the world on his shoulders. Areas
where ATLAS can help you shrug off unwanted fat include:
* **Arms**: Sculpts and shows off the biceps, triceps, and deltoids
* **Back**: Accentuates the latissimus muscles
* **Abdomen**: Removes fat above the abdominal muscles
* **Thighs**: Adds definition to the quadriceps for sexy, toned legs
* **Chest**: Creates well-defined pectoral muscles and reduces unsightly fat

[ATLAS Lipo ][140]

while preserving the natural integrity of the overlying skin and muscles. This advanced technique
helps achieve a revitalized, youthful appearance without compromising facial harmony.

procedures. Patients benefit from more dynamic and longer-lasting results, achieving a natural and

reduces sagging in both the face and neck, while maintaining a recovery period comparable to other
facelift methods. Dr. Chopra has dedicated decades to perfecting this approach, which has set a new
standard in facial rejuvenation and is now taught to surgeons around the globe.

Atlantis Lipo

With Atlantis, fat can be suctioned away from stubborn parts of the body, revealing the defined
muscle beneath. But why let all that good volume go to waste? Atlantis takes the fat that has been
suctioned away from areas where you don’t want it and places it where it can do some good. Atlantis
can suction fat from the following areas and can then be implanted in the breasts and buttocks to
increase curves. In some cases, the amount of fat transferred can rival that of an implant procedure
- without implants!
* **Abdomen**: Removes stubborn fat pockets and reveals muscle definition
* **Thighs**: Slenderizes and trims saddlebags and flank
* **Arms**: Increases muscle definition and removes unsightly fat
* **Back**: Reduces bulges or unsightly fat deposits

[Atlantis Lipo ][139]

ATLAS Lipo

ATLAS (Anatomically True Lipo Aspiratory Sculpting) a revolutionary liposuction procedure designed
to accentuate muscle — inspired by the mythical hero who carried the world on his shoulders. Areas
where ATLAS can help you shrug off unwanted fat include:
* **Arms**: Sculpts and shows off the biceps, triceps, and deltoids
* **Back**: Accentuates the latissimus muscles
* **Abdomen**: Removes fat above the abdominal muscles
* **Thighs**: Adds definition to the quadriceps for sexy, toned legs
* **Chest**: Creates well-defined pectoral muscles and reduces unsightly fat

Meet the Surgeon

## Maida Parkins, MD

Maida Parkins, M.D., is the founder and plastic surgery specialist of our practice. With more than a
decade of experience caring for patients, Dr. Parkins understands how difficult it can be to feel
confident when you are distracted by a body shape or an aged appearance that does not align with how
you feel internally.

[Meet The Surgeon][77]

Enhancement with intention

## Breast Procedures

Breast surgery at Parkins Plastic Surgery is all about achieving balance, enhancing beauty, and
making informed personal choices. Our team tailors each procedure to our clients’ individual needs,
while always keeping their goals in mind. Here, we’ll create a plan that’s true to you, whether that
means restoring volume with implants, refining your shape with a lift, or choosing to remove
implants.

Contouring with precision

## Body Procedures

From tummy tucks to liposuction and customized mommy makeovers, body contouring at Parkins Plastic
Surgery is designed to help our patients feel comfortable and confident in their own skin. Dr.
Parkins always takes the time to understand her clients’ goals, helping her create a natural,
flattering silhouette that fits you and your body.

[Body Procedures][89]

Rejuvenation With Artistry

Dr. Parkins offers facial procedures that refresh your appearance while preserving your unique
features. With a focus on youthful contours and subtle refinement, each treatment is carefully
designed to enhance without overdoing it. She specializes in rejuvenating procedures, including
eyelid surgery, neck liposuction, and ear reshaping, with results that speak for themselves.

# Our Specialty is liposuction.

Most patients want to have liposuction done by a doctor who specializes in this procedure because
daily, ongoing practice at sculpting the body allows the doctor to develop an experienced eye and a
singularly skilled hand.

Phoenix Liposuction Center™ is one of the rare cosmetic surgery practices in Phoenix, AZ that
specialize exclusively in performing liposuction surgery. Lead by Dr. William Hall and Dr. William
Shuell, Phoenix Liposuction Center™™ has administered an accredited liposuction training course that
offers advanced training techniques to other physicians from all over the world. You’re in the hands
of experts.


##### Questions & More

##### What is liposuction?

Liposuction is the removal of fat cells from the body by suction assisted surgery. Liposuction is
normally performed to re-contour the body and cosmetically improve the patient’s appearance by
suctioning out stubborn fatty bulges that cling to the body that have remained even after the
patient has tried to diet and exercise. Liposuction is a minimally-invasive fat-extraction method
and at Phoenix Liposuction Center™, we use an Awake Lipo method that uses only local anesthesia and
mild sedation, so the risks associated with the surgery are lower. Cosmetic surgeons Dr. William
Hall and Dr. William Shuell gently suction fat out of the body through tiny incisions using an
extremely thin tube. Our special surgical sculpting and contouring technique is known as
micro-liposuction and has a very high-level of precision.

##### How much does liposuction cost?

Liposuction cost can vary greatly depending on the patient; however, an average size woman 5’2” and
135 lbs. who desires her abdomen to be reduced can expect the following:
* $4000.oo
* This is approximate of course and based on the amount of fat in the treated areas. Price would
  fluctuate 10-15% up or down based on smaller or larger than average.
* If this same woman desires to add her waist/hips (mid-section) to the same surgery, only add
  $1000-$1500 more so a total of approximately $5300.
* As you can see the pricing gets progressively less as you add areas during the same procedure.
* All of the pricing is done on an individual basis when Dr. Hall or Dr. Shuell personally meets
  with you.

Here at Phoenix Liposuction Center™ we only engage patients with simple, straightforward surgical
quotes. We also do not utilize high-pressure sales tactics or follow up phone calls.

##### Do you offer financing?

Absolutely! At Phoenix Liposuction Center™, we offer several different financing options to make it
easier for our patients to afford all of the benefits of liposculpture. Our clinic has strong
relationships with reputable finance companies that regularly help our patients by offering both
advice and financial assistance.

Many of our patients are surprised by the affordability of liposuction surgery at Phoenix
Liposuction Center™, particularly when they explore our financing options. Financing applications
take only a few minutes to complete. The process is easy and afterwards, patients make affordable
monthly payments.

##### Which body areas can be treated?

Liposuction can be done on almost any area of the body. Many of our patients opt to target more than
one area of the body during their liposuction procedure because we offer discounts for multiple
target areas and because, by targeting multiple areas, patients see much more pronounced results.
There is a limit to how many areas can be treated in one session and this is dictated by the weight
of the patient and size of the areas.

## Founder & Chief Surgeon

### Over 26 Years and 20,000+ Successful Cases in Advanced Body Sculpting

With over 26 years of specialized surgical experience, Dr. William Hall is a nationally renowned
pioneer in advanced body sculpting and contouring techniques. Having performed more than 20,000
successful cases, Dr. Hall founded the Phoenix Liposuction Center™ to provide patients with an
unmatched level of precision and personalized care.

As a recognized leader in the field, Dr. Hall has administered accredited liposuction training
courses, sharing his advanced Awake Lipo techniques and safety protocols with physicians from around
the world. When you choose Dr. Hall, you are putting your body, your safety, and your aesthetic
goals in the hands of a true industry expert.

## Serving Greater Phoenix, Scottsdale, and Beyond

### Conveniently Located in Old Town Scottsdale, Arizona

Conveniently located in Old Town Scottsdale, Phoenix Liposuction Center™ proudly serves patients
throughout the greater Phoenix metropolitan area, East Valley, and international clientele seeking
premier body sculpting. Whether you are looking for localized fat reduction, a Brazilian Butt Lift
(BBL), or a comprehensive body contouring plan, Dr. William Hall’s state-of-the-art clinic delivers
world-class surgical results right here in the Valley of the Sun.

## Why Patients Choose GentleSculpt™ Awake Lipo

### Tumescent Local Anesthesia — No General Anesthesia Required

Unlike traditional liposuction procedures that require the high costs, deep risks, and groggy
recovery timelines of general anesthesia, Dr. William Hall utilizes a specialized Awake Lipo
methodology. By employing tumescent local anesthesia and mild sedation, patients remain completely
comfortable and conscious throughout the session.

Utilizing micro-cannulas, this highly precise fat-extraction method allows Dr. Hall to sculpt target
areas with artistic accuracy, drastically reducing post-operative swelling, bruising, and downtime.
This technique allows for the safe treatment of multiple body zones in a single session—maximizing
your physical transformation while prioritizing absolute medical safety.

# Our Specialty is liposuction.

Most patients want to have liposuction done by a doctor who specializes in this procedure because
daily, ongoing practice at sculpting the body allows the doctor to develop an experienced eye and a
singularly skilled hand.

Phoenix Liposuction Center™ is one of the rare cosmetic surgery practices in Phoenix, AZ that
specialize exclusively in performing liposuction surgery. Lead by Dr. William Hall and Dr. William
Shuell, Phoenix Liposuction Center™™ has administered an accredited liposuction training course that
offers advanced training techniques to other physicians from all over the world. You’re in the hands
of experts.


##### Questions & More

##### What is liposuction?

Liposuction is the removal of fat cells from the body by suction assisted surgery. Liposuction is
normally performed to re-contour the body and cosmetically improve the patient’s appearance by
suctioning out stubborn fatty bulges that cling to the body that have remained even after the
patient has tried to diet and exercise. Liposuction is a minimally-invasive fat-extraction method
and at Phoenix Liposuction Center™, we use an Awake Lipo method that uses only local anesthesia and
mild sedation, so the risks associated with the surgery are lower. Cosmetic surgeons Dr. William
Hall and Dr. William Shuell gently suction fat out of the body through tiny incisions using an
extremely thin tube. Our special surgical sculpting and contouring technique is known as
micro-liposuction and has a very high-level of precision.

##### How much does liposuction cost?

Liposuction cost can vary greatly depending on the patient; however, an average size woman 5’2” and
135 lbs. who desires her abdomen to be reduced can expect the following:
* $4000.oo
* This is approximate of course and based on the amount of fat in the treated areas. Price would
  fluctuate 10-15% up or down based on smaller or larger than average.
* If this same woman desires to add her waist/hips (mid-section) to the same surgery, only add
  $1000-$1500 more so a total of approximately $5300.
* As you can see the pricing gets progressively less as you add areas during the same procedure.
* All of the pricing is done on an individual basis when Dr. Hall or Dr. Shuell personally meets
  with you.

Here at Phoenix Liposuction Center™ we only engage patients with simple, straightforward surgical
quotes. We also do not utilize high-pressure sales tactics or follow up phone calls.

##### Do you offer financing?

Absolutely! At Phoenix Liposuction Center™, we offer several different financing options to make it
easier for our patients to afford all of the benefits of liposculpture. Our clinic has strong
relationships with reputable finance companies that regularly help our patients by offering both
advice and financial assistance.

Many of our patients are surprised by the affordability of liposuction surgery at Phoenix
Liposuction Center™, particularly when they explore our financing options. Financing applications
take only a few minutes to complete. The process is easy and afterwards, patients make affordable
monthly payments.

##### Which body areas can be treated?

Liposuction can be done on almost any area of the body. Many of our patients opt to target more than
one area of the body during their liposuction procedure because we offer discounts for multiple
target areas and because, by targeting multiple areas, patients see much more pronounced results.
There is a limit to how many areas can be treated in one session and this is dictated by the weight
of the patient and size of the areas.

## Meet Dr. William Hall:
## Founder & Chief Surgeon

### Over 26 Years and 20,000+ Successful Cases in Advanced Body Sculpting

With over 26 years of specialized surgical experience, Dr. William Hall is a nationally renowned
pioneer in advanced body sculpting and contouring techniques. Having performed more than 20,000
successful cases, Dr. Hall founded the Phoenix Liposuction Center™ to provide patients with an
unmatched level of precision and personalized care.

As a recognized leader in the field, Dr. Hall has administered accredited liposuction training
courses, sharing his advanced Awake Lipo techniques and safety protocols with physicians from around
the world. When you choose Dr. Hall, you are putting your body, your safety, and your aesthetic
goals in the hands of a true industry expert.

## Serving Greater Phoenix, Scottsdale, and Beyond

### Conveniently Located in Old Town Scottsdale, Arizona

Conveniently located in Old Town Scottsdale, Phoenix Liposuction Center™ proudly serves patients
throughout the greater Phoenix metropolitan area, East Valley, and international clientele seeking
premier body sculpting. Whether you are looking for localized fat reduction, a Brazilian Butt Lift
(BBL), or a comprehensive body contouring plan, Dr. William Hall’s state-of-the-art clinic delivers
world-class surgical results right here in the Valley of the Sun.

## Why Patients Choose GentleSculpt™ Awake Lipo

### Tumescent Local Anesthesia — No General Anesthesia Required

Unlike traditional liposuction procedures that require the high costs, deep risks, and groggy
recovery timelines of general anesthesia, Dr. William Hall utilizes a specialized Awake Lipo
methodology. By employing tumescent local anesthesia and mild sedation, patients remain completely
comfortable and conscious throughout the session.

Utilizing micro-cannulas, this highly precise fat-extraction method allows Dr. Hall to sculpt target
areas with artistic accuracy, drastically reducing post-operative swelling, bruising, and downtime.
This technique allows for the safe treatment of multiple body zones in a single session—maximizing
your physical transformation while prioritizing absolute medical safety.

### Natural-Looking Result

Natural tissue reconstruction creates soft, natural-looking breasts that age with you—no implants
needed.
[Plastic-Surgery.-Doctor-Hands-Wrapping-Female-Breast-In-Bandage]

### Dual-Surgeon Precision

Every DIEP flap procedure at PRMA is performed by two expert microsurgeons working together, not
one. This team-based approach improves precision, shortens time under anesthesia, and significantly
reduces the risk of complications, delivering safer surgeries and better long-term outcomes.
[close-up-woman-in-beige-underwear-conducts-a-breast-self-examination.-Prevention-of-diseases-of-the
-mammary-glands]

### Sensation Restoration with TruSense®

PRMA is a national leader in restoring breast sensation after reconstruction. Using proprietary
TruSense® techniques, our surgeons reconnect nerves during surgery, helping many women regain
feeling and reconnect with their bodies after cancer.
[doctor-and-patient-exam-consultation-in-clinic-office-holding-breast-enlargement-implant-in-hands-p
lastic-surgery-beauty-enhancement-medical-Mammoplasty-and-plastic-surgery-mastopexy]

### Proven Safer than Implants

Natural tissue reconstruction avoids the long-term risks associated with implants, including
rupture, capsular contracture, and repeat surgeries. Studies show higher complication rates with
implants, which is why PRMA is committed to offering a safer, longer-lasting reconstruction option
using your own tissue.
[natural looking]

### High-Definition Natural Results

Our High Def DIEP® technique delivers refined contouring and natural breast shape using your own
tissue. The result is a softer, more natural appearance that looks and feels like you, not a
reconstruction.
[specialists]

### Specialists in Complex & Revision Cases

PRMA is nationally recognized for treating patients with failed or painful implant reconstructions.
We specialize in converting implant-based reconstructions to natural tissue solutions when others
say it cannot be done.
[Carethattreats]

### Care That Treats the Whole Woman

Healing after breast cancer is physical and emotional. Our patient-centered approach focuses on
restoring confidence, dignity, and wholeness, not just reconstructing breasts.
