[Plastic-Surgery.-Doctor-Hands-Wrapping-Female-Breast-In-Bandage]

### Dual-Surgeon Precision

Every DIEP flap procedure at PRMA is performed by two expert microsurgeons working together, not
one. This team-based approach improves precision, shortens time under anesthesia, and significantly
reduces the risk of complications, delivering safer surgeries and better long-term outcomes.
[close-up-woman-in-beige-underwear-conducts-a-breast-self-examination.-Prevention-of-diseases-of-the
-mammary-glands]

### Sensation Restoration with TruSense®

PRMA is a national leader in restoring breast sensation after reconstruction. Using proprietary
TruSense® techniques, our surgeons reconnect nerves during surgery, helping many women regain
feeling and reconnect with their bodies after cancer.
[doctor-and-patient-exam-consultation-in-clinic-office-holding-breast-enlargement-implant-in-hands-p
lastic-surgery-beauty-enhancement-medical-Mammoplasty-and-plastic-surgery-mastopexy]

### Proven Safer than Implants

Natural tissue reconstruction avoids the long-term risks associated with implants, including
rupture, capsular contracture, and repeat surgeries. Studies show higher complication rates with
implants, which is why PRMA is committed to offering a safer, longer-lasting reconstruction option
using your own tissue.
[natural looking]

### High-Definition Natural Results

Our High Def DIEP® technique delivers refined contouring and natural breast shape using your own
tissue. The result is a softer, more natural appearance that looks and feels like you, not a
reconstruction.
[specialists]

### Specialists in Complex & Revision Cases

PRMA is nationally recognized for treating patients with failed or painful implant reconstructions.
We specialize in converting implant-based reconstructions to natural tissue solutions when others
say it cannot be done.
[Carethattreats]

### Care That Treats the Whole Woman

Healing after breast cancer is physical and emotional. Our patient-centered approach focuses on
restoring confidence, dignity, and wholeness, not just reconstructing breasts.

## Meet the Surgeons

Personalized Care from Two Dedicated Surgeons

At Plastic Surgery Associates of Long Island, skilled, Board-Certified plastic surgeons Sotirios
Papafragkou, MD, FACS, and Susie Rhee, MD, provide exemplary care to patients in Roslyn Heights, New
York, as part of a team of experienced surgeons.

Logo]

## Dr. Papafragkou

Board Certified Plastic Surgeon

Sotirios Papafragkou, MD, FACS, is a triple board-certified surgeon at Plastic Surgery Associates of
Long Island in Roslyn Heights, New York. Dr. Papafragkou is board-certified in plastic surgery, hand
and microvascular surgery, and general surgery. He is an active member of the American Society for
Surgery of the Hand (ASSH), the American Society of Plastic Surgeons (ASPS), and the Aesthetic
Society (ASAPS).

[Meet Dr. Papafragkou][67]
[home-about-img-2b]

## Dr. Rhee

Board Certified Plastic Surgeon

Susie Rhee, MD, is a board-certified female plastic surgeon at Plastic Surgery Associates of Long
Island in Roslyn Heights, New York. Dr. Rhee is based in Nassau County, New York, but serves all of
Long Island. She is a dedicated patient advocate whose priorities include patient safety,
satisfaction, and excellence in clinical care.

[Meet Dr. Rhee][68]

Neck [home-face-img-2b]
* [Facelift][69]
* [Lip Lift][70]
* [Brow Lift][71]
* [Rhinoplasty][72]

At Plastic Surgery Associates of Long Island, facial and neck surgery is based on clients’ anatomy
and proportions. Dr. Papafragkou and Dr. Rhee perform facelift and mini facelift surgery, neck lift,
brow lift, rhinoplasty, and neck and chin liposuction with an emphasis on refinement for results
that last for years to come.

[Face & Neck Procedures][73]

* [Upper Eyelid Surgery][74]
* [Lower Eyelid Surgery][75]
* [Ptosis Repair][76]
* [Asian Eyelid Surgery][77]

Dr. Papafragkou and Dr. Rhee provide upper and lower eyelid surgery, ptosis repair, and Asian eyelid
procedures, including minimally invasive techniques when indicated. Each treatment is selected to
preserve eyelid function while achieving a natural, rested appearance for our clients.

[Eyelid Procedures][78]

## Breast
* [Breast Reduction][79]
* [Breast Lift][80]
* [Breast Augmentation][81]
* [Breast Revision][82]

Breast surgery at Plastic Surgery Associates of Long Island is planned with longevity in mind.
Breast procedures we offer include breast augmentation, breast lift, breast reduction, revision, and
reconstruction. We will base these on clients’ body structure, tissue quality, and proportion for
natural-looking results.

[Breast Procedures][83]

## WHY CHOOSE RATTINAN CLINIC
* ได้รับการรับรองมาตรฐานระดับสากล
* ห้องผ่าตัดจากกระทรวงสาธารณสุข
* ห้อง Clean Room มาตรฐาน ISO 14644-1
* การรับรองปลอดเชื้อ COVID-19 จากกรมอนามัย
* คุณภาพต่อเนื่อง 3 ปีจาก AACI สหรัฐอเมริกา

[
[ได้รับการรับรองมาตรฐานระดับสากล][ได้รับการรับรองมาตรฐานระดับสากล]
][98]

##### เปิดให้บริการมาตั้งแต่ปี 1999

ดูแลคุณด้วยหัวใจ โดยทีมแพทย์ พยาบาล และเจ้าหน้าที่ ให้คุณมั่นใจในทุกขั้นตอน

##### ได้รับคะแนนรับรอง จาก AACI

รางวัล AACI Excellences Award 2025 ตอกย้ำมาตรฐานที่คุณมั่นใจได้ตั้งแต่ก้าวแรก

##### ผู้รับบริการกว่า 52 ประเทศทั่วโลกไว้วางใจ

ความเชื่อมันระดับนานาชาติ ภายใต้มาตรฐานการดูแลเท่าเทียมกัน

##### คลินิกสะอาดและเป็นส่วนตัว

บรรยากาศที่สะอาด เงียบสงบ และเป็นส่วนตัว ให้คุณรู้สึกผ่อนคลายทุกครั้ง

##### ปรึกษาแพทย์ ฟรี

ให้คำแนะนำโดยแพทย์เฉพาะทาง วิเคราะห์อย่างละเอียด รับฟังอย่างใส่ใจ

##### รับการ Prescreen ฟรี

วางแผนการดูแลเฉพาะคุณแบบ 360° ด้วยเครื่อง 3D Scan, อัลตราซาวด์ และ BMI

##### Aftercare ครบทุกขั้นตอน

มอบบริการดูแลหลังทำ เพื่อช่วยให้คุณฟื้นตัวได้อย่างมีประสิทธิภาพ

##### อุปกรณ์-เทคโนโลยีล้ำสมัย ผ่านมาตรฐาน

เราคัดสรรอุปกรณ์ทางการแพทย์ที่ได้รับการรับรองมาตรฐาน อย. ไทย และ US FDA

##### ดูแลโดยวิสัญญีแพทย์ตลอดการรักษา

วิสัญญีแพทย์ดูแล แบบ 1:1 อย่างใกล้ชิดเพื่อการการฟื้นตัวและคืนสติอย่างปลอดภัย

##### เทคนิคลดความเจ็บปวด 3 ระดับ เพื่อความสบายสูงสุด

เทคนิคการให้ยาชาหลายระดับเพื่อให้เหมาะสมกับแต่ละหัตถการ

##### เทคนิคยาชา Pure Tumescent ลดความเจ็บปวด

เทคนิค Pure Tumescent ในการให้ยาชา เพื่อช่วยลดความเจ็บปวดในการทำหัตถการ

##### เทคนิคยาชา Painless Pump ลดความเจ็บและปลอดภัย

เทคนิค Painless Pump ช่วยลดความเจ็บปวดในช่วงพักฟื้น

##### ราคาชัดเจน ไม่ชาร์จเพิ่มทีหลัง

นำเสนอราคาชัดเจน ไม่มีค่าธรรมเนียมแอบแฝง หรือค่าใช้จ่ายเพิ่มเติมที่ไม่เป็นธรรม

##### การดูแลอย่างครอบคลุม พร้อมติดตามผลระยะยาว

มอบการดูแลหลังการรักษาอย่างต่อเนื่อง พร้อมติดตามผลให้คุณมั่นใจในผลลัพธ์

##### ทีมแพทย์ของรัตตินันท์ คลินิก

แพทย์เฉพาะทางมากประสบการณ์ในแต่ละด้าน พร้อมผสานศาสตร์การแพทย์กับเทคโนโลยี

##### รับประกันเครื่องแท้ ตรวจสอบได้

ร่วมมือกับองค์กรมาตรฐาน เทคโนโลยีหรืออุปกรณ์คุณภาพ ตรวจสอบแหล่งที่มา

##### เปิดให้บริการมาตั้งแต่ปี 1999

ดูแลคุณด้วยหัวใจ โดยทีมแพทย์ พยาบาล และเจ้าหน้าที่ ให้คุณมั่นใจในทุกขั้นตอน

##### ได้รับคะแนนรับรอง จาก AACI

รางวัล AACI Excellences Award 2025 ตอกย้ำมาตรฐานที่คุณมั่นใจได้ตั้งแต่ก้าวแรก

##### ผู้รับบริการกว่า 52 ประเทศทั่วโลกไว้วางใจ

ความเชื่อมันระดับนานาชาติ ภายใต้มาตรฐานการดูแลเท่าเทียมกัน

##### คลินิกสะอาดและเป็นส่วนตัว

บรรยากาศที่สะอาด เงียบสงบ และเป็นส่วนตัว ให้คุณรู้สึกผ่อนคลายทุกครั้ง

##### ปรึกษาแพทย์ ฟรี

ให้คำแนะนำโดยแพทย์เฉพาะทาง วิเคราะห์อย่างละเอียด รับฟังอย่างใส่ใจ

##### รับการ Prescreen ฟรี

วางแผนการดูแลเฉพาะคุณแบบ 360° ด้วยเครื่อง 3D Scan, อัลตราซาวด์ และ BMI

##### Aftercare ครบทุกขั้นตอน

มอบบริการดูแลหลังทำ เพื่อช่วยให้คุณฟื้นตัวได้อย่างมีประสิทธิภาพ

##### อุปกรณ์-เทคโนโลยีล้ำสมัย ผ่านมาตรฐาน

เราคัดสรรอุปกรณ์ทางการแพทย์ที่ได้รับการรับรองมาตรฐาน อย. ไทย และ US FDA

##### ดูแลโดยวิสัญญีแพทย์ตลอดการรักษา

วิสัญญีแพทย์ดูแล แบบ 1:1 อย่างใกล้ชิดเพื่อการการฟื้นตัวและคืนสติอย่างปลอดภัย

##### เทคนิคลดความเจ็บปวด 3 ระดับ เพื่อความสบายสูงสุด

เทคนิคการให้ยาชาหลายระดับเพื่อให้เหมาะสมกับแต่ละหัตถการ

##### เทคนิคยาชา Pure Tumescent ลดความเจ็บปวด

เทคนิค Pure Tumescent ในการให้ยาชา เพื่อช่วยลดความเจ็บปวดในการทำหัตถการ

##### เทคนิคยาชา Painless Pump ลดความเจ็บและปลอดภัย

เทคนิค Painless Pump ช่วยลดความเจ็บปวดในช่วงพักฟื้น

##### ราคาชัดเจน ไม่ชาร์จเพิ่มทีหลัง

นำเสนอราคาชัดเจน ไม่มีค่าธรรมเนียมแอบแฝง หรือค่าใช้จ่ายเพิ่มเติมที่ไม่เป็นธรรม

##### การดูแลอย่างครอบคลุม พร้อมติดตามผลระยะยาว

มอบการดูแลหลังการรักษาอย่างต่อเนื่อง พร้อมติดตามผลให้คุณมั่นใจในผลลัพธ์

##### ทีมแพทย์ของรัตตินันท์ คลินิก

แพทย์เฉพาะทางมากประสบการณ์ในแต่ละด้าน พร้อมผสานศาสตร์การแพทย์กับเทคโนโลยี

##### รับประกันเครื่องแท้ ตรวจสอบได้

ร่วมมือกับองค์กรมาตรฐาน เทคโนโลยีหรืออุปกรณ์คุณภาพ ตรวจสอบแหล่งที่มา

# One surgeon. One patient a day. *The result you actually wanted.*

Dr. Daniel Schneider is board-certified in facial plastic surgery and books one surgery a day, so
the whole day belongs to you. Natural results from the face down, with none of the in-and-out
factory feeling.

[Schedule a Consultation][41]
[See Results][42]
[Dr. Daniel Schneider, board-certified facial plastic surgeon at Riverview Face & Body Aesthetics in
St. Paul]

Board-Certified, Head & Neck Surgery

ABFPRS Subcertification

University of Minnesota Trained

OHSU Fellowship

The Riverview Difference

### Most surgeons run patients in and out all day. ***Dr. Schneider does one surgery a day*** and
### builds the whole plan around you, from a natural deep plane facelift to the body and breast work
### you trust him for next.

[Riverview Face & Body Aesthetics facial plastic surgery clinic in St. Paul, Minnesota]
Sound Familiar?

## Tired of feeling like a number on someone's surgery schedule?

You have been thinking about this for a while. The last thing you want is a rushed consult and a
result that looks done to you instead of like you.

### It's hard to discover what surgeon has a great reputation.

Googling, word of mouth, a wall of before-and-after photos that all start to look the same. None of
it tells you who will treat your face like it matters.

### The factory model treats you like volume.

Big practices wheel patients in and out all day. Your questions get the short version and your
comfort comes second to the schedule.

### You are afraid of looking overdone.

The pulled, windswept look is exactly what you do not want. You want to look like yourself, rested
and natural, not like you had work done.

[Schedule a Consultation][43]
[See Results][44]
[Modern facial plastic surgery consultation suite at Riverview in the Twin Cities]
Worth Getting Right

## The wrong surgeon is a decision you wear every day.

> Cosmetic surgery is delicate and personal. Choose on price or a slick photo wall and you risk a
> result that looks overdone, a recovery nobody walked you through, and the quiet regret of wishing
> you had waited for someone who treated your face like it mattered. This is one decision where
> rushing costs the most.

Why It Feels Different Here


## The difference is the whole day belongs to you.

[Schedule a Consultation][45]
* The Typical Practice
  * Several surgeries crammed into one day
  * You meet the surgeon for a few rushed minutes
  * A different specialist for every body part
  * Several surgeries crammed into one day
  * Cookie-cutter results off a photo wall
* The Riverview Approach
  * One surgery a day, devoted entirely to you
  * Dr. Schneider takes the time the decision deserves
  * Tells you honestly if something is not a good fit
  * One trusted surgeon from the face on down
  * A plan built around your bone structure and your goals
After Riverview

# Feel confident in the way you look. For years, not months.

[Calm patient consultation room at Riverview Face & Body Aesthetics]
[Natural-looking facial rejuvenation result from Riverview Face & Body Aesthetics]

### Be known, not processed.

A surgeon who learns your story and stays your surgeon through every stage.

### Decide with confidence.

Honest answers, a clear plan, and a team that treats you as more than a number.

### Surgical Expertise & Genuine Care

**Dr Sheree Moko – Specialist Plastic Surgeon**

As a female Specialist Plastic Surgeon practising on the Gold Coast, I can offer a womanʼs
perspective combined with genuine care, surgical expertise and experience for a wide range of
plastic and reconstructive procedures. My highly trained team is committed to providing excellent
service in a discreet and professional manner before, during and after your surgery, as well as
performing a variety of non-surgical procedures and delivering evidence-based skin care.

Our rooms are conveniently located with ample parking at Robina. We are a short distance from
Coolangatta Airport, serving the Gold Coast, Brisbane, QLD, NSW and beyond.

burns), tumour, or birth deformities. She is also a highly trained and experienced surgeon in
cosmetic procedures that help restore, rejuvenate or improve a personʼs appearance. She is married
and a mother of two children.

### Surgical Expertise & Genuine Care

**Dr Sheree Moko – Specialist Plastic Surgeon**

As a female Specialist Plastic Surgeon practising on the Gold Coast, I can offer a womanʼs
perspective combined with genuine care, surgical expertise and experience for a wide range of
plastic and reconstructive procedures. My highly trained team is committed to providing excellent
service in a discreet and professional manner before, during and after your surgery, as well as
performing a variety of non-surgical procedures and delivering evidence-based skin care.

Our rooms are conveniently located with ample parking at Robina. We are a short distance from
Coolangatta Airport, serving the Gold Coast, Brisbane, QLD, NSW and beyond.

### Dr Sheree Moko - Specialist Plastic Surgeon

Dr Moko is the first New Zealand Maori woman surgeon. She is a passionate reconstructive Plastic
Surgeon, a discipline devoted to helping people affected by defects resulting from trauma (including
burns), tumour, or birth deformities. She is also a highly trained and experienced surgeon in
cosmetic procedures that help restore, rejuvenate or improve a personʼs appearance. She is married
and a mother of two children.

**Welcome to Signature Clinic**, where we combine expertise and care to offer a wide range of
cosmetic treatments designed around **you**. Our highly experienced, GMC-registered surgeons deliver
[**blepharoplasty**][245] (eyelid surgery), [**gynecomastia**][246] (male chest reduction) and a
wide range of cosmetic procedures, alongside advanced non-surgical aesthetic treatments. Whether
you’re looking to refresh your appearance or boost your confidence, we’re here to guide you every
step of the way.

Our clinics, located in key cities across the UK, are open 7 days a week, offering **free
consultations** to help you make an informed decision without any pressure. We understand that each
patient is unique, and our focus is on delivering **tailored treatment plans** that align with your
specific goals and needs.

At Signature Clinic, there are **no hidden fees**—just transparent, competitive pricing that you can
trust. To make your journey even easier, we work with leading finance partners to offer **0%
interest-free credit**, ensuring your chosen treatment is as accessible as possible.

From the first consultation to your post-treatment follow-ups, we prioritise **your comfort and
peace of mind**. We pride ourselves on a no-pressure, supportive approach, giving you the time and
space to explore your options with confidence. Our dedicated aftercare ensures you feel supported
long after your treatment, with flexible follow-up appointments to monitor your progress.

Thermage^{®} FLX

# INDICATION
* The **radiofrequency energy only delivery components of the Thermage system** and accessories are
  indicated for use in:
  * Dermatologic and general surgical procedures for electrocoagulation and hemostasis;
  * Non-invasive treatment of periorbital wrinkles and rhytids including upper and lower eyelids;
    and
  * Non-invasive treatment of wrinkles and rhytids.
* The **simultaneous application of radiofrequency energy and skin vibration by the Thermage
  system** and accessories are indicated for use in:
  * Dermatologic and general surgical procedures for electrocoagulation and hemostasis;
  * Non-invasive treatment of periorbital wrinkles and rhytids;
  * Non-invasive treatment of wrinkles and rhytids;
  * Temporary improvement in the appearance of cellulite;
  * Relief of minor muscle aches and pains;
  * Relief of muscle spasms; and
  * Temporary improvement of local circulation (blood circulation).

# IMPORTANT SAFETY INFORMATION
* Do not undergo a Thermage treatment if you have a cardiac pacemaker or other active implants.
  Inform your doctor if you have this condition or are in doubt.
* **The most common adverse effects include:**
  * Surface Irregularities: Frequently, surface irregularities are not evident immediately
    post-treatment, but may appear up to 1 or more months post-treatment.
  * Altered Sensation: Numbness, tingling, or temporary paralysis that typically resolves in a short
    period of time, but may persist up to several weeks.
  * Burns, Blisters, Scabbing, and Scarring: The procedure may produce heating in the upper layers
    of the skin, causing burns and subsequent blister and scab formation. There is a possibility of
    scar formation.
  * Lumps / Nodules: lumps or nodules under the skin may occur primarily in the neck area that
    usually resolve within 1 or 2 weeks without chronic or long term complications.
  * Pigment Changes: Hyperpigmentation (darkening of the skin) that normally resolves within several
    months.
  * Edema: Swelling may occur and typically resolves within 5 days, but can persist up to several
    weeks.
  * Mild to Moderate Pain: Typically, the discomfort is temporary during the procedure and localized
    within the treatment area.

**Talk to your doctor for more information about Thermage and see www.thermage.com for additional
details.**
Clear + Brilliant^{®}

# INDICATION

The Clear + Brilliant^{®} system is a non-ablative laser for general skin resurfacing, which can
help improve skin tone, texture, fine lines, and overall appearance of the skin, and reduce the
appearance of pore size.

# IMPORTANT SAFETY INFORMATION
* The following contraindications are routine for many laser treatments and may also be associated
  with non-ablative Clear + Brilliant^{®} laser system treatments. You may not be an appropriate
  candidate for a treatment if you:
  * Have been diagnosed with or possibly have actinic keratosis, melasma, rosacea, or other
    significant skin conditions (e.g., skin cancer, active infections, cold sores, open wounds or a
    sore that has not or will not heal, rashes, burns, inflammation, eczema, psoriasis);
  * Are predisposed to keloid formation or excessive scarring;
  * Have a condition that may compromise the immune system, or your ability to fight infections,
    such as HIV, lupus, scleroderma, or infections in the blood stream;
  * Have a known sensitivity to light or if you are taking any medications that may make your skin
    more sensitive to UV or artificial light;
  * Are on oral/systemic steroids (e.g., prednisone, dexamethasone), which should be rigorously
    avoided prior to and throughout the course of treatment;
  * Are using retinoids, which should be avoided for at least 2 weeks prior to and during treatment;
  * Are undergoing isotretinoin acne treatment or taking drugs in a similar class;
  * Have skin that is still recovering from a cosmetic procedure, such as a chemical or mechanical
    peel, or laser resurfacing; and
  * Have had botulinum toxin injections, or dermal fillers (such as collagen or hyaluronic acid)
    within the past 2 weeks.

**Talk to your doctor for more information about Clear + Brilliant^{®} and see
www.clearandbrilliant.com for additional details.**
Fraxel^{®}

for the following indications for use:

  treatment of dyschromia (an alteration in the color of the skin) and for local inflamed, benign
  skin lesions, such as, but not limited to, lentigos (small, pigmented, benign spots), sun spots,
  actinic keratosis (pre-cancerous skin lesions), and melasma; and for the treatment of wrinkles
  around the eyes, acne scars, and surgical scars.
* **Fraxel^{®} 1927nm** wavelength is indicated for skin resurfacing including for the treatment of
  actinic keratosis (pre-cancerous skin lesions); treatment of pigmented lesions, such as age spots,
  sun spots, and freckles.

# Because Your Well-Being Deserves the Best Care

** Where confidence and health come together.**

At IBI Clinic Tampa, we specialize in advanced weight loss, laser procedures, and aesthetic
procedures that change lives, not just appearances. Backed by cutting-edge technology and expert
surgical care, we put your safety first while delivering results you’ll love.

**Personalized care, proven results**

We are the premier destination for advanced weight loss and aesthetic procedures. With
state-of-the-art technology and expert specialists, we ensure your safety while delivering results
that restore health, confidence, and quality of life.

[Meet the Team Behind Your Care][15]

[ Book a Consultation ][16]
[Dr Chris ibikunle][Dr Chris ibikunle]

# What We Offer

Uncover a healthier, more confident version of yourself with our wide array of services tailored to
transform your life.

[Medical Weight Loss Services][Medical Weight Loss Services]

Medical Weight Loss Program

Medical weight loss aids higher-weight patients in improving health and sustaining long-term weight
loss under medical supervision.

[Aesthetics Services][Aesthetics Services]

Aesthetic & MED Spa

Restore a youthful appearance by reducing wrinkles, enhancing contours, and adding volume to
targeted areas for a smoother, rejuvenated look.

[IV Therapy Services][IV Therapy Services]

Hydration and Recovery Solutions

Quickly and efficiently replenish your body with hydration, essential vitamins, and minerals to
address nutrient deficiencies and support your overall well-being.

[Weight Loss Tampa][Weight Loss Tampa]

Surgical Weight Loss

Common obesity surgeries like gastric bypass, sleeve gastrectomy, and banding reduce food intake or
absorption to aid weight loss.

[Weight Loss][Weight Loss]

Non-Surgical Weight Loss

Spatz, Orbera Balloons & ESG offer incision-free procedures with no hospital stay and faster
recovery than surgery.

[Laser][Laser]

Laser Procedures

We specialize in advanced laser treatments, offering minimally invasive solutions for Fistulas,
Fissures, Cysts, and Hemorrhoids.

# Because Your Well-Being Deserves the Best Care

** Where confidence and health come together.**

At IBI Clinic Tampa, we specialize in advanced weight loss, laser procedures, and aesthetic
procedures that change lives, not just appearances. Backed by cutting-edge technology and expert
surgical care, we put your safety first while delivering results you’ll love.

**Personalized care, proven results**

We are the premier destination for advanced weight loss and aesthetic procedures. With
state-of-the-art technology and expert specialists, we ensure your safety while delivering results
that restore health, confidence, and quality of life.

[Meet the Team Behind Your Care][15]

[ Book a Consultation ][16]
[Dr Chris ibikunle][Dr Chris ibikunle]

# What We Offer

Uncover a healthier, more confident version of yourself with our wide array of services tailored to
transform your life.

[Medical Weight Loss Services][Medical Weight Loss Services]

Medical Weight Loss Program

Medical weight loss aids higher-weight patients in improving health and sustaining long-term weight
loss under medical supervision.

[Aesthetics Services][Aesthetics Services]

Aesthetic & MED Spa

Restore a youthful appearance by reducing wrinkles, enhancing contours, and adding volume to
targeted areas for a smoother, rejuvenated look.

[IV Therapy Services][IV Therapy Services]

Hydration and Recovery Solutions

Quickly and efficiently replenish your body with hydration, essential vitamins, and minerals to
address nutrient deficiencies and support your overall well-being.

[Weight Loss Tampa][Weight Loss Tampa]

Surgical Weight Loss

Common obesity surgeries like gastric bypass, sleeve gastrectomy, and banding reduce food intake or
absorption to aid weight loss.

[Weight Loss][Weight Loss]

Non-Surgical Weight Loss

Spatz, Orbera Balloons & ESG offer incision-free procedures with no hospital stay and faster
recovery than surgery.

[Laser][Laser]

Laser Procedures

We specialize in advanced laser treatments, offering minimally invasive solutions for Fistulas,
Fissures, Cysts, and Hemorrhoids.

## **Precision, ****Care, ****Integrity**

Mr Roshan Vijayan is an experienced Consultant Plastic Surgeon, with broad specialist training. With
a commitment to wellness and sustainable living, he emphasises natural, well-balanced results in his
aesthetic practice. Renowned for his artistry and clear communication, Mr Vijayan is dedicated to
training the next generation of surgeons and committed to his values of Precision, Care and
Integrity.

Precision
Care
Integrity

Surgery is a technical craft that requires an eye for detail, and high standards. I believe in
careful planning, as I would before undertaking an artwork. Most of the hard work is done before
picking up the scalpel, to visualise the final aesthetic, plan the approach, pre-empt any pitfalls,
and rehearse the steps.

I care about you as a patient, and my own performance.

Care incorporates your total experience, from your first visit, to your surgery, and after care. My
aim is to put you at ease, understand what you want, explain myself as clearly as possible and check
that you are happy. Then deliver results.

I take pride in communication, ensuring that you have as much information and support as you need. I
summarise all consultations in detailed letters, that serve as a recap for you, and help you
prepare. I always aim to be accessible either directly via email or through my admin team.

I see surgery as a partnership rather than as something I do to you. For a short time, you entrust
yourself to me and the operating theatre team, but for the most part it is a shared endeavour where
your views and understanding are crucial.

One of the great things about the UK is the National Health Service, which despite its challenges,
remains largely free at the point of use. This means that you can be confident that your doctor is
never incentivised to over-investigate or over-treat you, for financial gain. The result is
generally sensible, cost-effective decision making, with your best interests at heart.

Unfortunately the same is not always true in private healthcare, where the prospect of financial
reward can lead to gaming patients.

I am motivated primarily by the creative act of surgery, and the reward of great results. I
therefore pledge to:
* Always give you an honest impartial opinion
* Only recommend necessary tests and appointments
* Not suggest or recommend treatments which I do not believe are in your best interests
* Give you the option to transfer your care into the NHS if feasible and if you wish, for example
  for cancer follow-up
* Treat you as I would a relative or friend

London in 2008 with a first class intercalated degree in Endocrinology (hormonal and metabolic
health), and subsequently worked in over 20 hospitals during his training, spanning London,
Oxfordshire and Sussex. After general post-graduate training in medicine and surgery, he undertook
specialist training in plastic surgery at the Queen Victoria hospital, Royal London hospital, Royal
Free hospital, Chelsea & Westminster hospital, and Guys & St Thomas’ hospital.

This culminated in a sub-specialty fellowship period, before taking up a Consultant Plastic Surgeon
NHS post in Stevenage.

During his career he has published academic papers, presented nationally and internationally, and he
continues to play an active role in training the next generation of surgeons. He has visited
prestigious plastic surgery units at home and abroad, including South Korea and Taiwan, in order to
broaden his expertise.

His lifelong interest in wellness, fitness and sustainable living shapes his aesthetic practice. He
believes in natural, well balanced and proportioned results, where surgery complements health and
confidence. He is naturally creative, and well respected for his artistry, clear communication and
down to earth demeanour.

* MBBS Imperial College London

 
* MRCS (Eng), Member of the Royal College of Surgeons in England
* FRCS(Plast), Fellow of the Royal College of Surgeons in England
* Executive MBA

## **Precision, ****Care, ****Integrity**

Mr Roshan Vijayan is an experienced Consultant Plastic Surgeon, with broad specialist training. With
a commitment to wellness and sustainable living, he emphasises natural, well-balanced results in his
aesthetic practice. Renowned for his artistry and clear communication, Mr Vijayan is dedicated to
training the next generation of surgeons and committed to his values of Precision, Care and
Integrity.

Precision
Care
Integrity

Surgery is a technical craft that requires an eye for detail, and high standards. I believe in
careful planning, as I would before undertaking an artwork. Most of the hard work is done before
picking up the scalpel, to visualise the final aesthetic, plan the approach, pre-empt any pitfalls,
and rehearse the steps.

I care about you as a patient, and my own performance.

Care incorporates your total experience, from your first visit, to your surgery, and after care. My
aim is to put you at ease, understand what you want, explain myself as clearly as possible and check
that you are happy. Then deliver results.

I take pride in communication, ensuring that you have as much information and support as you need. I
summarise all consultations in detailed letters, that serve as a recap for you, and help you
prepare. I always aim to be accessible either directly via email or through my admin team.

I see surgery as a partnership rather than as something I do to you. For a short time, you entrust
yourself to me and the operating theatre team, but for the most part it is a shared endeavour where
your views and understanding are crucial.

One of the great things about the UK is the National Health Service, which despite its challenges,
remains largely free at the point of use. This means that you can be confident that your doctor is
never incentivised to over-investigate or over-treat you, for financial gain. The result is
generally sensible, cost-effective decision making, with your best interests at heart.

Unfortunately the same is not always true in private healthcare, where the prospect of financial
reward can lead to gaming patients.

I am motivated primarily by the creative act of surgery, and the reward of great results. I
therefore pledge to:
* Always give you an honest impartial opinion
* Only recommend necessary tests and appointments
* Not suggest or recommend treatments which I do not believe are in your best interests
* Give you the option to transfer your care into the NHS if feasible and if you wish, for example
  for cancer follow-up
* Treat you as I would a relative or friend

## LASIK

### Rediscover Clear Vision

Tired of reaching for glasses or fumbling with contact lenses every morning? LASIK might be the
solution you've been searching for. Our LASIK procedure can correct nearsightedness, farsightedness,
and astigmatism, offering you the freedom to see clearly without the hassle of corrective eyewear.

Take our LASIK Self Test to see if you're a candidate for this life-changing procedure. Say goodbye
to blurry vision and hello to a brighter, clearer future.

[
Take LASIK Self Test
][60] [
Request LASIK Consultation
][61]

## **Refractive Lens Exchange (RLE)**

### Enhance Your Vision, Elevate Your Life

RLE is a surgical procedure that is very similar to cataract surgery. The eye's natural lens is
replaced with an artificial one, called an intraocular lens, or IOL. This procedure can act as **an
alternative to LASIK surgery **and can significantly improve the vision of those with
nearsightedness.

Refractive Lens Exchange is an excellent alternative for those who are not candidates for LASIK.
This popular procedure can not only drastically improve your vision, but can also prevent you from
developing cataracts!

Find out more about the qualities of a good candidate for RLE and if you are a candidate for this
procedure by contacting our office today!

[
Request an RLE Consultation
][62]

## **Cataract Surgery**

### See Clearly Again

Is cloudy vision making daily tasks a challenge? Our cataract surgery could be the key to restoring
your sight and improving your quality of life. With advancements in premium cataract lens upgrades,
we offer personalized solutions tailored to your unique needs.

Curious if cataracts are affecting your vision? Take our Cataract Self Test and discover if it's
time to regain your clarity.

## Welcome to Whitson Vision

Our compassionate ophthalmologists and vision specialists empower individuals to navigate the world
with clarity and confidence.

At Whitson Vision, our commitment is clear: to deliver unparalleled service. Dr. William E. Whitson,
MD, recipient of the esteemed Best Doctors in America Award for an impressive 27 consecutive years,

your vision journey.

#### Focus on Precision and Patient Well-Being

**‍**Our specialists correct vision, reduce disease risks, and optimize eye health. Recognizing the

technology, from diagnostics to surgery.

## LASIK

### Rediscover Clear Vision

Tired of reaching for glasses or fumbling with contact lenses every morning? LASIK might be the
solution you've been searching for. Our LASIK procedure can correct nearsightedness, farsightedness,
and astigmatism, offering you the freedom to see clearly without the hassle of corrective eyewear.

Take our LASIK Self Test to see if you're a candidate for this life-changing procedure. Say goodbye
to blurry vision and hello to a brighter, clearer future.

[
Take LASIK Self Test
][60] [
Request LASIK Consultation
][61]

## **Refractive Lens Exchange (RLE)**

### Enhance Your Vision, Elevate Your Life

RLE is a surgical procedure that is very similar to cataract surgery. The eye's natural lens is
replaced with an artificial one, called an intraocular lens, or IOL. This procedure can act as **an
alternative to LASIK surgery **and can significantly improve the vision of those with
nearsightedness.

Refractive Lens Exchange is an excellent alternative for those who are not candidates for LASIK.
This popular procedure can not only drastically improve your vision, but can also prevent you from
developing cataracts!

Find out more about the qualities of a good candidate for RLE and if you are a candidate for this
procedure by contacting our office today!

[
Request an RLE Consultation
][62]

## **Cataract Surgery**

### See Clearly Again

Is cloudy vision making daily tasks a challenge? Our cataract surgery could be the key to restoring
your sight and improving your quality of life. With advancements in premium cataract lens upgrades,
we offer personalized solutions tailored to your unique needs.

Curious if cataracts are affecting your vision? Take our Cataract Self Test and discover if it's
time to regain your clarity.

work.

### Local production

Yasui medical products are designed and manufactured in Japan. This ensures full oversight of every
phase of production, reducing quality inconsistencies.

The koplight™ lighted retractor was a surgeon's idea. We made it a reality. We confer with doctors
on R&D and respond to doctors' needs.

Yasui's 90+ years of experience in materials development has required constant cooperation. We bring

We maintain communication with distributors and physicians so doctors can use our products with

the fact I was already scheduled with another surgeon. I immediately canceled and booked with Dr.

made sure I was comfortable and doing okay before, during, and after surgery. He is truly **an
artist with his craft**, too. The **staff is also amazing — they genuinely care** about their
patients and go above and beyond! Willis Cosmetic Surgery is a true gem! I am so thankful I chose
Dr. Willis and his team!

Highly recommend!
